title: A Field-Deployable 2U Ultra-Stable Laser with Sub-Hertz Linewidth Based on Optoelectronic Oscillator Locking
abstract: Compact, high-performance ultra-stable lasers that can operate outside the laboratory remain a long-standing goal. Here we report, to our knowledge, the most compact field-deployable ultra-stable laser, packaged in a standard 2U rack chassis. It is stabilized to a 50 mm-long, 19 mL optical reference cavity with low vibration sensitivity by optoelectronic oscillator (OEO) locking, an approach particularly suited to compact, transportable systems. The laser delivers an integrated linewidth of about 0.42 Hz and a fractional frequency stability of about 5E-15 at 1 s averaging time (about 2.2E-15 at 0.4 s). Measured phase noise approaches the cavity thermal-noise limit below 100 Hz and the theoretical OEO-locking limit from 100 Hz to 100 kHz. The system volume is roughly one quarter of the volume of previously reported integrated, transportable ultra-stable lasers of comparable performance, making it well suited for field applications in time-frequency metrology, quantum technologies, and environmental sensing.

title: Ultrahigh-speed digital holography reveals blood flow beneath the skin
abstract: Laser Doppler holography (LDH) leverages ultrahigh-speed digital holography to reveal blood-flow signals in vessels beneath the skin of the closed eyelid and around the eye. We demonstrate this in one volunteer using recordings acquired at approximately 16,000 frames/s under 10~mW of diffuse near-infrared illumination. Numerical Fresnel reconstruction and principal-component filtering reveal branching vascular patterns. These results extend an ocular imaging system to blood-flow visualization beneath the skin without requiring elaborate immobilization procedures.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates that ultrahigh-speed laser Doppler holography with numerical Fresnel reconstruction and principal-component filtering can visualize blood-flow signals and branching vascular patterns beneath the closed eyelid and around the eye from a volunteer using ~16,000 frames/s recordings under low-power (~10 mW) diffuse near-infrared illumination, without complex immobilization.

title: Laser-induced damage threshold of periodic plasmonic metasurfaces
abstract: Plasmonic metasurfaces enable strong nonlinear optical responses due to sub-wavelength field confinement, yet their performance is fundamentally limited by low laser-induced damage thresholds (LIDT). Here, we present a comprehensive experimental and numerical study of the interplay between surface lattice resonances (SLRs), second-harmonic generation (SHG), and LIDT in periodic gold nanobar metasurfaces. Angle-resolved measurements reveal that excitation of SLRs at the fundamental wavelength strongly enhances SHG efficiency while simultaneously reducing the LIDT. In contrast, excitation of an SLR at the second-harmonic wavelength does not affect the damage threshold, allowing the SHG signal to be maximized. Our findings establish a fundamental trade-off between nonlinear efficiency and optical robustness and provide design guidelines for optimizing periodic plasmonic metasurfaces for high-power nonlinear applications.

summaries.en: The paper experimentally and numerically shows that in periodic gold nanobar metasurfaces, exciting surface lattice resonances (SLRs) at the fundamental wavelength boosts second-harmonic generation but lowers the laser-induced damage threshold, whereas exciting an SLR at the second-harmonic wavelength maximizes SHG without changing the damage threshold, revealing a fundamental trade-off and offering design guidance for high-power nonlinear metasurfaces.
summaries.zh: 论文通过实验与数值研究表明，在周期性金纳米条元表面中，激发表面晶格共振（SLR）于基频可增强二次谐波产生（SHG）但会降低激光诱导损伤阈值；而在二次谐波波长处激发表面晶格共振不会改变损伤阈值，从而能在不损害鲁棒性的情况下最大化SHG，揭示了非线性效率与光学稳健性之间的基本权衡并给出高功率非线性应用的设计指引。

title: Gradient-Free Inverse Design of 3D Nanophotonic Devices Using the Level-Set-Method
abstract: Advances in 3D nanophotonic additive manufacturing enable increasingly complex, almost free-form devices for manipulating light at sub-wavelength scales. Extending nanophotonic designs into three dimensions introduces additional degrees of freedom. Exploiting this freedom requires inverse-design methods that can efficiently navigate this large design space while accommodating fabrication constraints. Here, we combine gradient-free optimization with the level-set method (LSM) to provide such an approach for 3D additive manufacturing. Representing the 3D geometry as a level set constructed from Gaussian radial basis functions retains substantial geometric freedom with only a few hundred design variables. This compact representation makes gradient-free optimization practical for fully 3D nanophotonic devices, eliminating the need for adjoint calculations. This unlocks the use of any Maxwell solver or auxiliary algorithms that should express fabrication constraints for which the required derivatives are unavailable or impractical to obtain, and enables embarrassingly parallel workflows. Consequently, binary fabrication requirements, such as structural connectivity, can be rigorously enforced, avoiding the differentiable approximations commonly used in gradient-based optimization. Here, we demonstrate the combination of the gradient-free LSM with a connected-component analysis algorithm to enforce the structural integrity of the design. We demonstrate the applicability of the gradient-free LSM by optimizing a Y-splitter while strictly enforcing the structural integrity of the material and the void in the design.

summaries.en: The paper presents a gradient-free inverse-design framework for fully 3D nanophotonic devices that uses a level-set geometry parameterized by Gaussian radial basis functions to enable efficient optimization without adjoint gradients and to strictly enforce binary fabrication constraints like structural connectivity via connected-component analysis, demonstrated on a Y-splitter design.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种用于三维纳米光子器件的无梯度逆向设计框架：用由高斯径向基函数构建的水平集来参数化几何，从而在无需伴随梯度的情况下实现高效优化，并通过连通分量分析严格执行诸如结构连通性等二值化制造约束，论文以Y型分光器的设计验证了该方法的适用性。

title: Towards dense optical communications with partially coherent light: II. Multimode Stokes communications
abstract: Partially coherent light has a higher informational-carrying capacity than coherent light when both fields are spanned by the same modes, which implies that partially coherent light may increase the channel density in optical communications. A partially coherent field spanned by $N_{\mathrm{f}}$ modes can multiplex $N_{\mathrm{D}}=N_{\mathrm{f}}^{2}-1$ data streams in the generalized Stokes parameters that uniquely identify its coherence matrix -- a scheme we call `Stokes communications' (S-Comm). We have proposed in an accompanying paper a realization of S-Comm for bimodal fields $N_{\mathrm{f}}=2$ that multiplex $N_{\mathrm{D}}=3$ data streams. Here we extend this proposed strategy for S-Comm to multimode fields $N_{\mathrm{f}}>2$. We find that the diagonal and off-diagonal Stokes parameters require different treatments and we provide detailed designs for the transmitter and receiver for both diagonally and off-diagonally multiplexed data streams. The building blocks of the proposed system can be readily implemented in integrated photonic circuit platforms. Our results indicate that on-chip processing of multimode partially coherent light (or `structured coherence') may have profound implications for optical communications and for optical signal processing in general.

summaries.en: The paper extends “Stokes communications” to multimode partially coherent light, showing how a field spanned by Nf modes can multiplex Nf²−1 coherency-encoded data streams using generalized Stokes parameters with distinct transmitter/receiver designs for diagonal versus off-diagonal components, and argues that the approach is readily implementable on integrated photonic circuits for higher channel density and on-chip signal processing.
summaries.zh: 本文将用于双模情形的“Stokes 通信”扩展到多模部分相干光，证明当一个场由 Nf 个模张成时可通过广义 Stokes 参数复用 Nf²−1 个由相干矩阵唯一表征的数据流，并针对对角与非对角 Stokes 参数给出不同的发射端/接收端设计，且指出该方案可在集成光子平台上实现，从而可能显著提升光通信信道密度并推动片上光信号处理。

title: Subpicosecond Optical Time Transfer under Simulated Motion with Electro-Optic Frequency Combs
abstract: Extension of high performance optical frequency comb-based time transfer to real-world systems is challenged by platform motion, particularly for large relative velocities. Here, we utilize agile electro-optic frequency combs to construct a laboratory-based simulator of a two-way optical time transfer system under motion. Through direct control of the electro-optic frequency comb parameters, we can artificially induce the effects of relative motion. We performed tests of the time transfer performance across a km-scale fiber link for velocity profiles that linearly increase from rest up to 400 m/s. Through a post-processed data analysis, we demonstrate continuous tracking of the clock offset between sites with subpicosecond precision throughout the velocity sweep. These results illustrate the versatility of using electro-optic frequency combs for optical time transfer in deployed systems.
subjects: Optics (physics.optics) ; Instrumentation and Methods for Astrophysics (astro-ph.IM); Instrumentation and Detectors (physics.ins-det)

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates a laboratory simulator of two-way optical time transfer under simulated high-velocity platform motion using agile electro-optic frequency combs, achieving continuous sub-picosecond tracking of clock offset over a km-scale fiber link up to 400 m/s.
summaries.zh: 论文利用可敏捷调控的电光频率梳在实验室中构建了两路光学时间传递的运动仿真平台，通过直接控制梳参数模拟相对运动，在千米级光纤链路上实现了从静止到400 m/s速度扫掠过程中钟差的连续亚拍秒级跟踪，从而展示了电光频率梳用于部署系统光学时间传递的灵活性。

title: Intense and stable second-harmonic generation in robust MePEA-based quasi-2D halide perovskite crystals
abstract: Quasi-2D halide perovskites offer a unique platform for nonlinear optics applications, where structural and optical properties are tuned by the variation of organic spacer cations. Notably, quasi-2D perovskite single crystals can demonstrate intense and stable second-harmonic generation signals when a proper composition is selected. Here, the influence of phenethylammonium and 4-methyl-2-phenylethylammonium spacers on the crystal symmetry and second-harmonic signal response of quasi-2D perovskite phases with a varying number of single-octahedron [PbX$_6$]$^{4-}$ layers ($n$) is investigated. High-quality perovskite crystals with lateral dimensions of several hundred micrometers are fabricated using a cavity-confined crystallization synthesis method. Optical characterization of the crystals shows strong and temporally stable second-harmonic generation. Power-dependent and polarization-resolved measurements confirm the second-order nonlinear origin of the observed response and reveal anisotropic emission patterns. Our results demonstrate a direct correlation between spacer-induced center-symmetry breaking and nonlinear optical activity. These results establish quasi-2D halide perovskites as a promising class of symmetry-engineered materials for efficient frequency conversion and integrated nonlinear photonics.

summaries.en: The paper investigates how phenethylammonium versus 4-methyl-2-phenylethylammonium spacers affect quasi-2D halide perovskite crystal symmetry and yields temporally stable, intense, anisotropic second-harmonic generation that power- and polarization-resolved measurements confirm as a second-order nonlinear process linked to spacer-induced center-symmetry breaking.
summaries.zh: 论文研究了苯乙胺与4-甲基-2-苯乙基胺两种有机间隔基团如何影响具有可变n层单八面体[PbX6]4−结构的准二维卤化物钙钛矿晶体的对称性，并在实验中获得强且时间稳定的二次谐波信号；通过功率依赖和偏振分辨测量证实其为二阶非线性起源，且结果表明间隔基诱导的中心对称破缺与非线性光学活性之间存在直接关联，显示出其作为对称工程材料用于高效频率转换与集成非线性光子学的潜力。

title: What Can Next Generation Ultrafast Light Sources Tell Us About Quantum Materials?
abstract: Ultrafast spectroscopy of quantum materials has emerged as a principle application of modern ultrafast optical sources. Measurements made with ultrashort pulses allow the normally strongly coupled internal degrees of freedom inside these systems to be de-coupled in the time-domain, revealing the key interactions for the different orders that lead to dramatic emergent phenomena. This has naturally motivated a wide range of experiments, and quantum materials have now been studied with ultrafast sources spanning from the hard X-ray to the THz, with fields intense enough to create non-equilibrium states, and using pulses down to the attosecond duration. As the optical spectroscopist's toolbox becomes increasingly complete, it is worth pausing and reflecting on what are the capabilities that we currently lack for examining quantum materials, and what are the problems that require the next generation of ultrafast sources now coming on-line or being designed. Here I will offer an overview of the remaining missing capabilities in ultrafast optical sources as required for studying quantum materials, and identify some outstanding problems where I believe these new sources can provide decisive impact in our understanding of quantum and strongly-correlated materials.

summaries.en: The paper reviews how ultrafast spectroscopy using increasingly capable light sources decouples quantum-material degrees of freedom in time to expose key interactions and discusses the missing experimental capabilities and open problems that next-generation ultrafast sources (from X-ray to THz, down to attoseconds) are expected to address.
summaries.zh: 论文回顾了利用日益完善的超快光源进行超快光谱学如何在时间域中解耦量子材料的内部自由度，从而揭示关键相互作用，并讨论了研究量子材料所需但仍缺失的实验能力以及下一代超快光源（覆盖X射线到太赫兹并可达阿秒量级）有望带来决定性影响的未解决问题。

title: Mapping the High-Field Response of Superconducting Nanowire Single-Photon Detectors
abstract: Superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors (SNSPDs) are increasingly being integrated into cryogenic quantum-sensing platforms that operate in large magnetic fields. Here, the high-field limits of these measurements were probed by characterizing the dark count response of a NbTiN SNSPD at up to 14~T using in situ control of the detector orientation and benchmarking that performance against normal detector operation in smaller magnetic fields. The detector performance is strongly anisotropic: perpendicular magnetic fields rapidly reduce the usable bias-current range, whereas near-parallel alignment enables operation at substantially larger total fields, with a finite operating margin retained to 12~T and measurable dark-count response at the 14~T field limit. The angular dependence is governed predominantly by the perpendicular component of the magnetic field, consistent with vortex-mediated suppression of the superconducting current scale. The same field-dependent current scale also determines the electrical pulse amplitude, linking high-field detector operation directly to readout performance. These results establish a practical route for deploying SNSPDs in multi-tesla quantum-sensing and high-field cryogenic experiments.

summaries.en: The paper characterizes the high-field limits of a NbTiN superconducting nanowire single-photon detector up to 14 T by varying detector orientation to study the dark-count response and shows strong anisotropy dominated by the perpendicular magnetic-field component, which sets both an operating bias-current margin through vortex-mediated current suppression and the electrical pulse amplitude, enabling practical use of SNSPDs in multi-tesla cryogenic quantum-sensing experiments.
summaries.zh: 论文通过在原位改变NbTiN超导纳米线单光子探测器的朝向来表征其最高14 T下的暗计数响应，并将其与较低磁场下的正常工作基准对比，结果表明探测器对磁场方向高度各向异性，主要由垂直磁场分量主导并通过涡旋介导的超导电流抑制来决定可用偏置电流范围且在12 T仍保留有限工作裕量、14 T仍可观测暗计数，同时这种场依赖电流尺度还直接关联电学脉冲幅度，从而为在多特斯拉强磁场的低温量子传感与高场实验中部署SNSPD提供了可行路径。

title: Optical symmetry breaking for single-image field reconstruction
abstract: Light carries information in both amplitude and phase, although cameras record only intensity. Reconstructing the optical field is at the heart of wavefront sensing, microscopy and coherent communications. Existing methods often rely on multiple measurements or iterative phase retrieval. In fields described by known spatial modes, intensity is determined by pairwise products of their complex coefficients. Yet optical symmetries can make these products indistinguishable, leaving different fields with nearly identical images. Here, we show that engineering the optical measurement to break these symmetries enables direct reconstruction of the complex field from a single intensity image. We optimise a phase mask followed by propagation to separate pairwise modal signatures while retaining light on the detector. A calibrated linear inverse and rank-one projection then recover modal amplitudes and relative phases without iterative phase retrieval. In simulations, optimised masks satisfy conditioning and light-capture requirements unmet by random masks. Experiments reconstruct 42-mode fibre fields using either a spatial light modulator or a passive diffuser, with median complex-field errors of 9.1% and 4.6%, respectively, against holographic references. This extends an earlier five-mode experimental demonstration of fast intensity-only modal decomposition. Per-frame computation takes 2.1 ms, and batched throughput exceeds 4,000 frames per second. These results establish measurement-space symmetry breaking as a route to rapid single-image optical field reconstruction.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates that by engineering the optical measurement to break symmetry, a single intensity image can be used to directly reconstruct a complex optical field in known-mode systems without iterative phase retrieval, using an optimized phase mask with propagation plus linear inversion and rank-one projection, validated by simulations and experiments reconstructing 42-mode fiber fields with small complex-field errors and real-time computational throughput.
summaries.zh: 本文通过设计打破光学测量对称性的方案，实现了在已知空间模系统中仅凭单张强度图像直接重建复光场，并在无需迭代相位检索的情况下使用优化相位掩膜与传播、线性反演和秩一投影来恢复模态幅度与相对相位；论文通过仿真与实验（重建42模光纤场）验证该方法，复光场误差较小且具有毫秒级、每秒数千帧的计算吞吐率。

title: Integrated optical isolators enabled by 2D semiconductors via spin-momentum locking
abstract: Integrated optical isolators based on spin-momentum locking hold great potential for protecting photonic integrated circuits from unwanted reflections. Currently, the most common implementations are magneto-optical isolators that require an externally applied magnetic field. Nevertheless, a wide range of nonreciprocal effects remains to be exploited in alternative material platforms. Although the majority of these effects induce changes to the propagation of light as a function of its polarization, they can be directly connected to the propagation direction through spin-momentum locking. We employ a computational approach to investigate various designs of integrated isolators based on nonreciprocal 2D semiconductors, studying the influence of their geometry and optical properties on the device performance. Additionally, we propose a novel concept for an all-optical isolator based on spin-valley polarization and optically tunable magnetism in transition metal dichalcogenide monolayers. Our results establish 2D semiconductors as an advanced platform for integrated nonreciprocal devices, enabling functionalities that are difficult to achieve with conventional magneto-optical materials like all-optical operation.
subjects: Optics (physics.optics) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall); Applied Physics (physics.app-ph)

summaries.en: The paper computationally explores integrated optical isolator designs using 2D semiconductors that provide nonreciprocity via spin-momentum locking and proposes an all-optical isolator concept based on spin-valley polarization and optically tunable magnetism in transition-metal dichalcogenide monolayers, positioning 2D materials as a platform for nonreciprocal integrated devices beyond conventional magneto-optical approaches.
summaries.zh: 论文通过计算研究利用2D半导体的自旋-动量锁定实现非互易性的集成光学隔离器设计，并提出基于自旋-谷极化及过渡金属硫族化物单层中光学可调磁性的全光隔离器新概念，表明2D材料是实现比传统磁光材料更难获得功能的非互易集成器件平台。

title: Axial von Mises Framework for Tensor-Dependent Second-Harmonic Generation
abstract: We derive closed-form relations between projected fibril-axis statistics and tensor-dependent second-harmonic generation (SHG) harmonics using a single axial von Mises population. Under coherent emission within domains and detected intensity addition across domains, each angular harmonic factors into a local tensor coefficient and an axial circular moment. Parallel-analyzer detection contains second, fourth and sixth harmonics; ideal equal-weight analyzer-free detection contains second and fourth harmonics. The resulting formulas identify geometry-specific harmonic zeros, sensitivity loss and ambiguous inversion of a secondary fixed-angle ratio. In particular, the analyzer-free fourth-harmonic zero at $\rho=1/3$ does not imply loss of all orientation sensitivity. Prepared-cornea forward/reverse recordings illustrate extraction of empirical analyzer-free harmonics. In the bundle ROI, second harmonics are resolved in both sweeps, while their normalized amplitudes differ and fourth harmonics remain unresolved. An exploratory central ROI from the same recordings yields a different forward/reverse profile. Within the same operator-identified tissue, low-signal space coverage and apparent fibre alignment vary slightly across recordings. These observations support angular-measurement feasibility while leaving quantitative normalized-shape agreement unestablished. The thermal extension illustrates consequences of assumed kinetics rather than calibrated tissue trajectories. The contribution is an analytical interpretation of SHG harmonics with explicit conditions for physical inference; the measurements do not establish absolute susceptibility ratio $\rho$, axial concentration $\kappa$, or experimental separation of thermal disorder from degradation.

summaries.zh: 论文基于单一轴向冯·米塞纤维取向分布，推导了张量依赖二次谐波产生的闭式谐波关系，展示了不同分析器几何如何产生特定谐波零点并影响灵敏度与反演，并通过角膜记录表明角向测量的可行性，但尚未确证关键定量参数（如磁化率比、轴向浓度）以及热动力学假设与组织真实轨迹之间的可分性。

title: Bright and Uniform Silicon Carbide Nanophotonic Arrays for Scalable Nanoscale Quantum Sensing
abstract: Silicon carbide (SiC) spin defects are emerging as powerful platforms for nanoscale quantum sensing due to their near-surface stability, near-infrared emission, and CMOS compatibility. However, poor photon collection efficiency and the reliance on randomly distributed defects hinder the realization of practical, large-scale devices. Here, we demonstrate scalable, ultra-bright, and highly uniform SiC quantum nanophotonic arrays. By combining a self-aligned fabrication process with localized oxygen ion implantation, we deterministically position PL5 and PL6 centers at the exact center of 4H-SiC nanopillars. This architecture yields record-high photon count rates of $\sim$1 Mcps (PL5) and $\sim$2 Mcps (PL6), establishing a new benchmark for SiC color centers while maintaining near-identical brightness across the array. Furthermore, we apply these devices to nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), successfully demonstrating external nanoscale nuclear-spin detection. These results establish our SiC nanopillars as robust building blocks for scanning quantum probes and scalable sensor networks.

summaries.en: The paper reports a scalable fabrication method to deterministically position bright, highly uniform SiC PL5/PL6 spin defects at the centers of SiC nanopillars, achieving record photon count rates and enabling external nanoscale NMR nuclear-spin detection for scalable quantum sensing devices.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种可扩展的制造方法，使SiC中的PL5/PL6自旋缺陷被确定性地精确定位到SiC纳米柱中心，获得创纪录的高光子计数率并实现外部纳尺度NMR核自旋探测，从而构建可扩展的量子传感器器件。

title: An optical-frequency-comb-enabled unified infrastructure for quantum networks
abstract: Quantum networks require precision timing and classical communication to coordinate distributed quantum operations, yet these functions are typically supported by separate infrastructures, increasing system complexity and limiting scalability. Here we demonstrate an optical-frequency-comb-enabled infrastructure that unifies precision timing, classical communication and quantum communication over a shared fibre link. By encoding classical data onto the intensity of the comb while retaining its pulse timing, we simultaneously transmit data at 100 Mbit/s and achieve a timing stability of 0.85 fs at 1 s over 100 km. We develop a spectral-engineering strategy to suppress the coupling between data modulation and timing extraction. We further establish a power-dependent model of the excess noise induced in a co-propagating continuous-variable quantum key distribution channel, identifying optical power, wavelength allocation and propagation direction as the principal control parameters. After optimization, the system introduces only 0.0037 shot noise unit of additional excess noise and limits the secret-key-rate penalty to 6.7%. Furthermore, quantum-secured timestamp transmission additionally enables absolute time synchronization with a stability of 0.26 fs at 1 s. These results establish optical frequency combs as a common physical layer for integrated quantum-network services.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates an optical-frequency-comb-based unified fibre infrastructure that concurrently provides high-stability precision timing and high-rate classical communication with quantum networking services, including optimized timing extraction and a controlled co-propagating continuous-variable QKD noise model to limit secret-key-rate penalties.
summaries.zh: 本文提出并验证了一种基于光学频率梳的统一光纤基础设施，可在同一链路上同时实现高稳定精密计时与高速经典通信，并通过光谱工程抑制数据调制与计时提取的耦合，建立了协同传播连续变量量子密钥分发通道的噪声控制模型，使额外噪声与秘密密钥速率惩罚分别仅为极小水平并可进一步实现量子安全时间戳同步。

title: TARANG: an open-source, cost-controlled design workflow for silicon nitride microcomb chips
abstract: Designing a microresonator frequency comb chip means solving a chain of coupled problems: a waveguide with anomalous dispersion that survives fabrication errors, a ring with the right free spectral range and quality factor, a bus gap that sets the coupling regime, and grating couplers, all made in one lithography step. We present TARANG, an open-source Python package that takes a silicon nitride platform from tabulated refractive indices to a GDSII mask in fourteen stages, built on the Tidy3D mode, FDTD and eigenmode-expansion solvers. Every cloud simulation is priced before it runs and capped, every result is cached by a fingerprint of the full simulation, and every quoted number carries a numerical check. We show that snapping the grid onto the core's faces, a common way to steady dispersion calculations, leaves the field samples on the faces to floating-point rounding, and that averaging solves with the grid just inside and just outside the faces makes the group-velocity dispersion $D$ independent of the computer and steady to about 1 ps/(nm km) from mesh to mesh. Two complete air-clad designs are presented, at 1550 nm ($700\times1000$ nm core, $D = 372.9 \pm 0.6$ ps/(nm km)) and at 780 nm ($350\times500$ nm, $D = 196.4 \pm 0.9$ ps/(nm km)), each with a 200 GHz ring, critical and over-coupled gaps, grating couplers, and a fibre-to-fibre budget. The predicted dispersion agrees with two measured devices from the literature to within 1 and 4%, and an independent Lugiato-Lefever solver forms stable single solitons from the exported parameters of both designs, which are ready for fabrication.

summaries.en: The paper presents TARANG, an open-source Python workflow that cost-controls and verifies simulations while designing silicon nitride microcomb chips from refractive-index tables to GDSII masks, including methods to make dispersion grid-independent and two validated air-clad designs whose predicted dispersion matches literature measurements and enables stable single-soliton states via a Lugiato–Lefever solver.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了TARANG，一个开源的Python设计流程：通过对仿真进行成本控制、结果缓存与数值校验，将硅氮化物微梳芯片从折射率表推进到GDSII掩膜，并给出了使色散对网格不敏感的方法，同时给出两套空气包层设计，其色散预测与文献测量吻合，并且将导出的参数用于Lugiato–Lefever求解即可稳定生成单孤子，适合后续加工。

title: PISim: A Unified Photonic Inference Simulator for Hardware-Aware Cross-Layer Design-Space Exploration
abstract: Photonic neural accelerators offer ultra-low latency linear algebra, yet their usable numerical precision, sustainable throughput, and application accuracy remain tightly bounded by surrounding electro-optical interfaces and physical non-idealities. Pre-fabrication design-space exploration (DSE) requires a cross-layer electronic design automation (EDA) framework capable of evaluating disparate optical topologies under identical neural workloads and physical assumptions. We present \textbf{PISim}, a unified Photonic Inference Simulator that couples pretrained deep neural network execution with physics-based models of six accelerator architecture families, six electro-optic modulator technologies, four optical source organizations, and direct or coherent readout schemes. PISim embeds stage-resolved impairment operators---covering control and analog-to-digital quantization, finite extinction ratio, shot noise, correlated relative-intensity noise (RIN), thermal drift, propagation loss, and channel crosstalk---alongside an analytical cycle-level interface timing model to expose electronic-optical bottlenecks. Using simulated MNIST multilayer perceptron (MLP) benchmarks, we demonstrate how PISim identifies optimal precision operating points under multi-impairment stress (peaking at 6 bits for Mach--Zehnder and microring modulators), quantifies a 52.5 percentage-point accuracy gap between VCSEL-array and parallel-fanout laser architectures arising, under the modeled conditions, from power partitioning and correlated source noise, and models interface-limited throughput scaling across emitter-array widths from 32 to 128 channels. This comprehensive framework establishes an extensible, reproducible foundation for accuracy-constrained Pareto optimization prior to photonic tape-out.

summaries.en: PISim is a unified, hardware-aware photonic inference simulator that couples pretrained neural workloads with physics-based models of diverse optical accelerator architectures and electro-optic components to evaluate impairments and interface timing for accurate, Pareto-style design-space exploration before photonic tape-out.
summaries.zh: PISim是一个统一的、面向硬件的光子推理模拟器，它将预训练神经网络负载与多样光学加速器架构及电光器件的物理建模相耦合，通过评估器件失效与接口时序瓶颈，为进行精度约束的帕累托型设计空间探索提供可复现基础，并用于光子流片前的优化。

title: Phonon-mediated visible upconversion luminescence in femtosecond 1030-nm pumped Tm3+ -doped silica fibres
abstract: We investigate multiphoton absorption-driven visible luminescence in a thulium-doped aluminosilicate optical fiber excited by an ultrafast 1030-nm femtosecond pulse train in the {MHz domain}. We report the observation of an unusual spectral crossover: the predominance of an emission band centered at 457-nm (deep blue) is progressively overtaken by a second emission, centered at 475-nm (cyan), as launched average power increases. Concurrently, a third near-infrared emission around 792~nm exhibits persistent, monotonic growth characterized by a well-defined bilinear slope transition. By combining calibrated spectral band integration with a structure-informed rate-equation model based on host thermodynamics, we show that the visible spectra evolution is governed by non-radiative multi-phonon transfer and phonon-assisted cross-relaxation activated by cumulative core heating, rather than permanent color-center solarization. These results offer new predictive insights into the thermal and spectroscopic stability of high-power ultrafast fiber systems.

summaries.en: The paper studies multiphoton, phonon-assisted visible upconversion luminescence from Tm3+-doped aluminosilicate fibers pumped by MHz-rate femtosecond 1030-nm pulses, finding a power-dependent spectral crossover from a 457-nm to a 475-nm band while a 792-nm near-IR emission grows monotonically with a bilinear slope transition, and modeling these behaviors as arising from cumulative core heating that drives non-radiative multi-phonon transfer and phonon-assisted cross-relaxation rather than permanent solarization, thereby informing thermal and spectroscopic stability predictions for high-power ultrafast fiber systems.
summaries.zh: 该论文研究了在 MHz 域重复的 1030 nm 飞秒泵浦下，Tm3+ 掺杂铝硅酸盐光纤中由多光子驱动的声子介导可见上转换发光，发现随功率增加发射光谱在 457 nm（深蓝）主导向 475 nm（青色）发生谱线交叉，而 792 nm 近红外发射随功率单调增长并呈现清晰的双线性斜率转变；通过结合校准后的谱带积分与基于宿主热力学的结构化速率方程模型，作者证明可见光谱演化由累积的芯层加热激活的非辐射多声子转移及声子辅助能量交叉弛豫所主导，而非永久性的色心太阳化，从而为高功率超快光纤系统的热稳定性与光谱稳定性提供可预测的依据。

title: Optical fiber shape sensing using picosecond spatiotemporal single-photon reflectometry
abstract: Inferring the three-dimensional configuration of a flexible optical fiber from a single accessible end remains a fundamental challenge in photonic sensing. Existing approaches typically require specialised multicore fibers, coherent interferometry, or distributed spectral encoding. Here, we demonstrate a fundamentally different sensing paradigm in which fiber geometry is reconstructed from the spatiotemporal dynamics of returning single photons. Using a laser-engineered multimode fiber interrogated by a time-resolved 32x32 single-photon avalanche diode array, we show that fiber deformation imprints unique signatures onto the distribution and arrival time of back-reflected photons. We map these high-dimensional photon-return states onto a low-dimensional geometric manifold, enabling continuous bend-angle estimation and reconstruction of previously unseen two- and three-dimensional shapes from measurements acquired entirely at the proximal fiber end. Measurements show a median pixel-wise signal-to-noise ratio of approximately 26 dB and below 1% repeatability variation. Our results establish multimode single-photon dynamics as an information-rich channel for distributed geometric sensing, introducing a new framework for single-ended fiber shape reconstruction and minimally invasive photonic navigation.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates single-ended 3D optical fiber shape sensing by reconstructing geometry from the spatiotemporal arrival-time and spatial distribution of back-reflected single photons using a laser-engineered multimode fiber and a time-resolved 32×32 single-photon detector array mapped onto a low-dimensional manifold, enabling continuous bend-angle estimation and reconstruction of previously unseen 2D/3D shapes with high signal-to-noise and repeatability.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种仅用近端单端测量的三维光纤形状感知方法：通过激光工程化的多模光纤及时间分辨的32×32单光子探测阵列，利用回返单光子的时空分布与到达时间重建纤维几何形状，并将高维光子返回态映射到低维几何流形上，从而实现连续弯曲角估计及对先前未见的二维/三维形状重建，且具有约26 dB的像素级信噪比中位数与小于1%的重复性变化。

title: Chiral high harmonic generation via coherent superposition of multi-channel interband transitions
abstract: Circularly polarized light, with its specific handedness, is a valuable tool for investigating the chirality related properties of materials, including their structural, electronic, magnetic and topological characteristics. This has led to efforts in creating wavelength-tunable coherent light with circular or elliptical polarization through a sub-cycle ultrafast process high-harmonic generation (HHG). Existing approaches to chiral HHG, however, typically rely on multidimensional driving fields, materials engineering or complex optical architectures. Here we uncover a distinct mechanism without such complexity, where a single linearly polarized driving field generates chiral HHG from a pristine crystal. We show that, in the Weyl semimetal NbP, one linearly polarized near-infrared driving field generates high harmonics with pronounced ellipticity. Semi-conductor Bloch equations (SBEs) reveal that this ellipticity originates from the coherent superposition of multiple interband transitions, each contributing harmonics with distinct linear polarizations and relative phases. We further substantiate this mechanism by shifting the driving photon energy into the mid-infrared, which strongly suppresses the ellipticity as the number of accessible interband transition channels is reduced. These results establish a simple and general mechanism for chiral HHG, and show that quantum materials can transform an apparently achiral driving field into polarization-tunable ultrafast chiral emission.

summaries.en: The paper proposes and demonstrates a simple mechanism for generating chiral high-harmonic emission from a pristine Weyl semimetal (NbP) using a single linearly polarized driving field, where the resulting harmonic ellipticity arises from coherent superposition of multiple interband transition channels and is suppressed when shifting the driving energy to the mid-infrared by reducing available channels.
summaries.zh: 本文在不引入复杂光学结构的情况下，展示了用单一线偏激光驱动NbP（类韦尔半金属）即可从本征晶体产生手性高次谐波；其椭圆偏振性源于多条能带跃迁通道的相干叠加（各通道给出不同线偏振的谐波并具有相对相位），并通过将驱动光子能量移至中红外、从而减少可及跃迁通道数，发现椭圆性显著被抑制。

title: Enabling Mie Resonances for Optomagnetism in Epitaxially Grown Garnet Nanodisks via Photonic Crystals
abstract: An all-garnet photonic-crystal substrate compatible with epitaxial growth on gadolinium gallium garnet is proposed for controlling the optomagnetic response of a single bismuth iron garnet nanodisk. The photonic environment modifies the spectral positions and relative strengths of the electric- and magnetic-dipole contributions and redistributes the optical field inside the disk. Compared with a reference nanodisk on a homogeneous substrate evaluated near the broad maximum of its summed multipolar response, the peak axial optical contribution to the inverse Faraday effect in the examined cross-sections is enhanced by factors of approximately 7.3 and 6.3 in the magnetic- and electric-dipole-dominated regimes, respectively. The enhancement reaches approximately 7.9 at the maximum of the summed multipolar scattering contributions. These results demonstrate spectral control of the magnitude and spatial distribution of the local optomagnetic response through the photonic environment, without changing the nanodisk geometry.

summaries.en: The paper proposes an epitaxially compatible all-garnet photonic-crystal substrate that tailors the optomagnetic response of a single bismuth iron garnet nanodisk by shifting and reweighting its electric- and magnetic-dipole resonances and redistributing the internal optical field, yielding up to ~7.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种可外延生长的全石榴石光子晶体衬底，通过调控单个铋铁石榴石纳米圆盘的电偶极与磁偶极共振位置及相对强度并重分配其内部光场，从而在不改变纳米圆盘几何形状的情况下增强轴向法拉第反效应相关的局部光磁响应：在磁偶极主导与电偶极主导区分别约增强7.

title: Inverse Design of an On-chip Phase-Change Switch Composed of Sparse Heterogeneous Metasurfaces
abstract: Photonic switches are exploited for optical signal routing and control within optical communication systems. The integration of phase change materials with silicon photonic switches overcomes the drawbacks of the state-of-the-art photonic switches based on electro-optic and thermo-optic effects. In this work, a 1x2 on-chip switch with a footprint of 6.3umx31um based on on-chip one-dimensional metasurfaces is inverse-designed. The on-chip metasurfaces are heterogeneous, which their meta-atoms can be composed of either SiO2 or the phase-change material Sb2Se3. This helps to the realization of higher extinction ratio between the switch outputs, especially at the amorphous state which has a small refractive index contrast to that of the silicon. To benefit from structural, fabrication and switching simplicity, sparse parameterization is followed in the inverse design of the switch using ternary search (TS) and particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithms.

summaries.en: The paper presents an inverse-designed 1×2 on-chip photonic phase-change switch using sparse heterogeneous one-dimensional metasurfaces whose meta-atoms are formed from either SiO2 or Sb2Se3 to achieve a high extinction ratio, particularly in the amorphous state, while using ternary search and particle swarm optimization for fabrication- and switching-friendly design parameter sparsity.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种基于稀疏异构的一维片上超表面的反向设计1×2光子相变开关，其中元原子可由SiO2或Sb2Se3构成，从而在非晶态（折射率对比小于硅）下仍实现较高的消光比，并通过三元搜索与粒子群优化对设计参数进行稀疏化以兼顾结构、制造与开关的简化。

title: Enhancing optomechanical oscillation amplitude and frequency comb bandwidth by intensity-modulated driving
abstract: Self-sustained oscillations in optomechanical systems are attractive as compact, low-noise sources of GHz signals and optical frequency combs for integrated photonic circuits. For these applications, the achievable oscillation amplitude directly sets clock power and comb bandwidth. This work studies the maximum amplitude that can be reached through combinations of cavity backaction and modulated optical driving, with realistic resources. For an optically driven mechanical resonator, the oscillation amplitude saturates at a level set by the finite cavity bandwidth. We show that modulating the input intensity near the mechanical resonance frequency raises the achievable amplitude toward this limit at equal mean input power and cavity linewidth. We use a cycle-averaged energy-balance analysis to identify the added power that shifts the stable periodic orbit to larger amplitudes. Numerical integration of the full equations of motion confirms the enhancement across two decades of cooperativity and sideband-resolution ratios from 0.1 to 10. The relative increase in amplitude is largest near the self-oscillation threshold and in the sideband-unresolved regime, enabling threshold-free large-amplitude oscillation where backaction alone fails to do so. The enhanced amplitude leads to a larger modulation depth of the optical field, enabling broader frequency combs, with improved stability of the comb spacing. Intensity-modulated driving thus offers power-constrained platforms a simple open-loop route to larger mechanical amplitudes and enhanced comb bandwidth.

summaries.en: The paper shows that intensity-modulated optical driving of an optomechanical resonator, analyzed via cycle-averaged energy balance and verified by full numerical dynamics, can substantially enhance self-sustained oscillation amplitude toward the cavity-bandwidth-limited maximum and thereby broaden and stabilize optical frequency comb bandwidth across wide parameter ranges where backaction alone is insufficient.
summaries.zh: 本文通过循环平均能量平衡分析并用完整动力学方程的数值计算验证，表明在受限功率平台上对光学腔机械系统施加接近机械共振频率的强度调制驱动，可显著将自激振荡幅度提升至由腔带宽限制的上限并进而拓宽、稳定光学频率梳带宽；在宽参数范围内尤其能在后向作用（仅后向作用）无法实现大幅度振荡的区域实现无阈值的增强。

title: Thulium- and Holmium-Doped Silica Fibres for 2 μm High-Power and Highly-Efficient Lasers
abstract: Silica optical fibres, originally developed as a low-loss transmission medium for telecommunications, have evolved into a versatile platform for compact and efficient high-power lasers. This review discusses recent progress in thulium- and holmium-doped active fibres emitting within the 2 {\mu}m spectral band, with an emphasis on material and waveguide approaches that address power scaling through thermal-load mitigation and enhanced laser efficiency. In particular, the temperature dependence of absorption and emission cross-sections are reviewed, and their implications for spectral gain, amplified spontaneous emission and high-power laser operation are discussed. Structured-core thulium fibres are then considered as a route to combining the high local Tm3+ concentration required for efficient two for- one cross-relaxation with a reduced average dopant concentration, lower longitudinal heat load, and a pedestal-free waveguide design. Finally, recent results on holmium-doped silica fibres prepared by nanoparticle-assisted modified chemical vapour deposition are summarised. Crucially, the Al/Ho ratio is identified as a key compositional parameter governing laser efficiency, while a high absolute alumina content supports a long fluorescence lifetime and enables high Ho3+ concentrations without excessive clustering. These advances have enabled core-pumped holmium fibre lasers with slope efficiencies reaching 84% and output powers approaching 100W. Collectively, these development illustrate how control of spectroscopy, composition, and transverse dopant distribution can extend the performance of silica fibre lasers across the 1.7-2.2 {\mu}m spectral region.

summaries.en: The paper reviews advances in thulium- and holmium-doped silica fibers for high-power, highly efficient ~2 μm lasers, focusing on temperature-dependent spectroscopy, thermal-load mitigation, and waveguide/material designs such as structured-core Tm fibers and composition-controlled nanoparticle-assisted Al/Ho-doped Ho fibers that have enabled ~100 W core-pumped Ho fiber lasers with up to 84% slope efficiency.
summaries.zh: 本文综述了用于约2 μm波段高功率、高效率硅基光纤激光的铥（Tm）和钬（Ho）掺杂进展，重点讨论吸收/发射截面的温度依赖性、通过材料与波导设计实现的减热负载与效率提升，以及结构化芯层Tm光纤与纳米颗粒辅助改良化学气相沉积制备的组成受控Ho光纤（尤其是Al/Ho比）如何实现最高约84%斜率效率并接近100 W的芯泵浦Ho光纤激光输出。

title: UV and deep-UV ultrafast harmonic generation enhanced by resonant gold nano-pillar metasurface
abstract: We report experimental observations and full-vector numerical simulations of second and third-harmonic generation from a two-dimensional periodic gold nano-pillar metasurface, for efficient ultrafast light conversion from near-infrared to the UV and deep-UV spectral ranges. The metasurface is designed to support an angle-tunable plasmonic resonance in the near-infrared spectral range, with its resonance wavelength shifting as a function of the pump angle of incidence. Under resonant conditions, strong electromagnetic-field confinement near the nano-pillar corners enhances the nonlinear light-matter interactions. Compared with a flat gold mirror, the nanostructured metal exhibits enhanced nonlinear frequency conversion, with conversion efficiencies of second and third-harmonic generation increased by two and three orders of magnitude, respectively. Full-wave theoretical modeling of linear and nonlinear light-matter interaction in nanoscale structures validates the experimental results. We demonstrate that periodically arranged square gold pillars can be engineered to achieve enhanced second and third-harmonic generation at wavelengths that can be tailored through the structural design, without requiring complex geometries or hybrid structures that pose fabrication challenges. The close agreement between theoretical predictions and experimental measurements further advances our understanding of surface-mediated nonlinear optical processes in metals and highlights the potential of metallic nanostructures as ultrafast light sources in the UV and deep-UV.

summaries.en: The paper experimentally and numerically demonstrates that an angle-tunable resonant gold nano-pillar metasurface can greatly enhance ultrafast second- and third-harmonic generation from near-infrared to UV and deep-UV through resonant electromagnetic field confinement, achieving orders-of-magnitude higher conversion efficiencies than a flat mirror and matching full-wave theory with tailored emission wavelengths via simple periodic square pillars.
summaries.zh: 该论文通过实验与全波数值模拟表明，具有角度可调谐共振的金纳米柱元表面可因共振条件下的近柱角强电磁场束缚而显著增强近红外到紫外/深紫外的超快二次与三次谐波产生，其二/三次谐波转换效率相较平面金镜分别提升两个与三个数量级，并且利用周期性正方金柱的结构设计可定制谐波波长，理论预测与实验结果高度一致。

title: Asymmetric Frequency Conversion and Violation of Kirchhoff's Law of Thermal Radiation in Phased Floquet Metasurfaces
abstract: We study a system of three closely spaced conducting sheets, whose thermal emission largely violates Kirchhoff's law through nonreciprocal frequency conversion enabled by Floquet phenomena. We leverage surface mode transitions controlled by temporal modulation of one of the metasurfaces, resulting in largely asymmetric frequency conversion. Our findings broaden the capabilities of Floquet metasurfaces for wave conversion and energy manipulation, paving the way towards magnet-free nonreciprocal photonic devices with opportunities for thermal management and efficient photonic refrigeration.

summaries.en: The paper analyzes three closely spaced conducting sheets whose temporally modulated Floquet metasurfaces enable strongly asymmetric, nonreciprocal frequency conversion that causes thermal emission to largely violate Kirchhoff’s law, suggesting new routes to magnet-free nonreciprocal photonic devices for wave energy manipulation, thermal management, and photonic refrigeration.
summaries.zh: 论文研究了三个彼此紧密相邻的导电片体系，其中通过对一片超表面进行时间调制所产生的Floquet非互易频率转换，使热辐射在很大程度上违背基尔霍夫定律，并实现了表面模态的受控跃迁与显著非对称的频率转换，为无磁的非互易光子器件及能量操控、热管理和光子制冷提供了新思路。

title: Circuit-aware protection against burst errors in lattice surgery
abstract: Large-scale quantum computing will require logical operations protected against high-energy impacts that disturb many superconducting qubits at once. Gap engineering suppresses relaxation induced by these impacts, but protecting only a subset of qubits requires choosing where that protection is placed. During lattice surgery, measurements change as patches merge and split, exposing different ancillas and temporal boundaries to burst errors. Here we compare three static protection layouts for a simulated lattice-surgery CNOT, matching the numbers of protected ancillas and the X:Z check-type splits. At distance 9, protecting the check type measured during each merge reduces burst-induced excess risk by $38^{+6}_{-5}\%$ relative to a deep geometric band under correlated background matching, without giving the decoder the impact parameters. We attribute this difference to report errors at temporal boundaries and ancilla faults propagating to data, which interact to increase the excess risk of a shallow band. We also find that the typed layout reaches the shallow-band reference risk with an estimated $49^{+2}_{-14}$ fewer protected ancillas. At distance 13, the advantage is not resolved under oracle decoding, and a five-round burst cap reverses the shallow-band ordering. These results indicate how the measurements of a logical circuit can guide protection placement within the simulated decoder and burst-duration regimes tested here.

summaries.en: The paper compares static error-protection layouts for a simulated lattice-surgery CNOT under burst errors, finding that protecting the check type measured at each merge at code distance 9 significantly lowers burst-induced excess risk versus a deep geometric band and explains the gap via boundary report errors and ancilla-fault propagation, with mixed outcomes at distance 13 depending on decoding assumptions and burst-duration caps.
summaries.zh: 论文在模拟晶格手术的CNOT电路中比较了三种针对突发错误的静态保护布局，发现码距离9时在每次合并过程中保护所测的校验类型可比深几何带显著降低突发诱导的额外风险，并将差异归因于时间边界处的上报错误及辅助比特故障向数据的传播；但在码距离13下优势在理想解码下未能稳定重现，且引入五轮突发上限后排序会反转，表明电路测量结构可在本文测试的解码器与突发持续时间区间内指导保护放置。

title: Controlled preparation and unconditional transport on a fluctuating quantum graph
abstract: Lieb--Robinson bounds limit the spread of quantum information, but do not establish that a prescribed input can be prepared and transmitted with appreciable probability. For quantum graphs with fluctuating edges, connecting spectral propagation to unconditional readout also requires control of graph coherence, finite boundaries, and preparation errors. We address this problem in a one-probe model on a prescribed square candidate lattice, combining a generalized Rokhsar--Kivelson parent, spectral reduction, adiabatic preparation, and local dynamical estimates. Assuming a supplied coherent graph ground state, we construct a finite-source wave packet and a hopping ramp that populate an isolated branch with strictly positive group velocity. We prove an unconditional arrival probability of at least $5/8$ in a specified receiver region of a sufficiently large finite open square. Explicit bounds on local joint-state and Hamiltonian errors retain a lower probability of $9/16$, without requiring global many-body state closeness or postselection on graph measurements. Exact arithmetic certificates and a separate small-system numerical diagnostic support the quantitative analysis. The construction provides a model-specific benchmark for transport and readout in fluctuating quantum networks, linking a propagation mechanism to an observable lower bound and identifying the local error budgets required to preserve it. It distinguishes suppression of unwanted influence from guaranteed signal delivery, a useful separation for quantum-network and emergent-geometry models. The resource estimates are conservative, graph-state supply is assumed, and the result does not establish background-free geometry or gravitational dynamics.

summaries.en: The paper develops a one-probe quantum-graph transport scheme with controlled adiabatic preparation and local error bounds showing an unconditional wave-packet arrival probability ≥5/8 (with a lower bound ≥9/16 when including specific Hamiltonian/initial-state imperfections) in a finite open square despite fluctuating edges, without global many-body state closeness or postselected graph measurements.
summaries.zh: 该论文在带有边涨落的量子图网络中提出一种单探测器输运方案，通过广义Rokhsar–Kivelson母哈密顿量、谱化简与绝热制备并结合局域误差估计，证明在足够大的有限开方形内波包可在指定接收区域无条件到达，理想情况下到达概率≥5/8、考虑给定局域联合态与哈密顿量误差后仍≥9/16，且无需全局多体态接近性或对图测量的事后选择，并辅以精确算术证书与小系统数值诊断来支撑定量分析。

title: Towards Distributed Quantum Computing: Quantum Gate Teleportation via Satellite-Distributed Entanglement under Atmospheric Depolarization
abstract: We investigate quantum gate teleportation as a primitive for satellite-enabled distributed quantum computing. In the considered architecture, a satellite distributes entangled photon pairs to two optical ground stations, which transfer the shared quantum resource to remote quantum processing units. This entanglement is then used to implement a nonlocal controlled-NOT gate between two circuit qubits located in different processors. We formulate the minimal four-qubit protocol, consisting of two network qubits that provide the entangled resource and two circuit qubits on which the distributed gate is performed. Atmospheric propagation effects in the gravitational field are modeled through an effective two-qubit depolarizing channel whose parameters depend on atmospheric and optical quantities, including the Fried parameter and receiver aperture. The performance of the protocol is quantified by the fidelity between the ideal CNOT output state and the state produced by noisy quantum gate teleportation. Our results show that the fidelity is governed by the quality of the distributed entanglement and depends jointly on atmospheric coherence, aperture size, and effective depolarization strength. These findings connect physical-layer modeling of satellite optical channels with gate-level performance in distributed quantum computing.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Atmospheric and Oceanic Physics (physics.ao-ph); Optics (physics.optics); Space Physics (physics.space-ph)

summaries.en: The paper proposes a satellite-based distributed quantum computing architecture using quantum gate teleportation to implement a nonlocal controlled-NOT gate via entanglement shared between two ground stations, modeling atmospheric effects as an effective two-qubit depolarizing channel and quantifying protocol fidelity against channel parameters like atmospheric coherence, receiver aperture, and Fried parameter.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种利用卫星分发纠缠并进行量子门远程传态的卫星式分布式量子计算方案，以在不同处理器中的电路量子比特之间实现非局域受控非（CNOT）门；作者将大气传播影响等效为由大气相干性、接收口径与Fried参数等决定的双量子比特去极化信道，并通过理想CNOT输出态与含噪门远程传态产生的态之间的保真度评估性能，揭示保真度由分布式纠缠质量及其与大气去相干和去极化强度的共同作用所主导。

title: Quantum Telatar formula: fading quantum capacity of Haar-random multimode attenuators
abstract: Cellular communication is done over an imperfectly predictable multimode environment, where the sender only knows about the distribution of possible intermode coupling and scattering a signal faces. It may thus seem surprising that such communication is efficient. Telatar proved that the sender's lack of exact knowledge about the channel, on average, does not significantly hinder multimode communication. As the number $N$ of modes increases at fixed signal-to-noise ratio, the average capacity of a classical multimode fading channel grows linearly in $N$, like that of $N$ decoupled single-mode channels. We study the quantum analogue in a Haar-random passive bosonic network and prove a similar scaling for unassisted quantum information transmission. Suppose that the sender drives a fixed fraction of the input modes and the receiver collects more than half of the output modes. Then the quantum capacity of such channels at zero temperature grows linearly with the number of modes at fixed photon number per mode, just like the classical capacity grows with the number of antennas. At nonzero temperature, the Haar-averaged coherent information of the isotropic thermal input bounds the capacity from below, and its value per mode converges to an integral against Wachter's law. We numerically identify positive achievable rates in models motivated by cryogenic microwave networks and room-temperature multimode fibers.

summaries.en: The paper proves that for Haar-random multimode attenuators modeled as passive bosonic networks, the unassisted quantum capacity under partial mode access scales linearly with the number of modes at fixed per-mode photon number (and at nonzero temperature is bounded via Haar-averaged coherent information converging to a Wachter-law integral), with supporting numerics for cryogenic and room-temperature fiber/microwave-inspired models.
summaries.zh: 本文证明，在将哈阿随机多模衰减器建模为被动玻色网络的情况下，当发送端只激励固定比例输入模、且接收端收集超过一半输出模时，无辅助量子容量在每模固定光子数条件下随模数线性增长；在非零温度下，利用哈阿平均相干信息给出下界，其每模值收敛到对威赫特（Wachter）定律的积分，并用受冷却微波网络与室温多模光纤启发的数值模型验证了可实现的正传输速率。

title: Reducing TLS Losses in Superconducting Circuits Using Solid Neon
abstract: Two level systems (TLSs) are a major source of loss in superconducting devices, limiting the performance of qubits, detectors, and resonators. These defects arise from a range of sources, including surface oxides, crystal defects, as well as fabrication residues which are often difficult to remove. Using NbTiN coplanar waveguide resonators, we show that depositing and subsequently removing a solid neon film can significantly improve device performance. Analysis of the temperature and power dependence indicates that this enhancement arises from reduced TLS dissipation, which we attribute to the redistribution and removal of surface contaminants during neon deposition and evaporation. Atomic force microscopy images of contaminated hexagonal boron nitride flakes before and after neon exposure show that neon treatment can redistribute and remove surface residues. These results demonstrate a simple, non-destructive approach for mitigating TLS losses in superconducting devices and other sensitive materials that cannot withstand aggressive cleaning processes.

summaries.en: The paper reports that depositing and removing a solid neon film on NbTiN coplanar waveguide resonators reduces two-level-system (TLS) dissipation by redistributing and removing surface contaminants, thereby significantly lowering TLS losses and improving device performance.
summaries.zh: 该论文表明，在NbTiN共面波导谐振器上沉积并随后去除固态氖膜能够通过重新分布并去除表面污染物来降低两能级系统（TLS）的耗散，从而显著减少TLS损失并提升器件性能。

title: An Architecture for Real-Time Quantum Error Correction with Neutral Atoms
abstract: The latency of quantum measurement and classical decoding constrains the execution of adaptive fault-tolerant circuits. In neutral-atom processors, this requirement couples spatially resolved fluorescence detection to classical inference. Here we implement cascaded readout and decoding in a heterogeneous architecture that overlaps acquisition and processing at two spatial scales. Field-programmable gate arrays process camera rows as they arrive, while graphics processors decode an acquired logical block during acquisition of the next. This heterogeneous architecture offers flexibility in the choice of error-correcting codes and decoding algorithms. Direct communication preserves microsecond-scale transfer times for kilobyte payloads and supports interchangeable decoding algorithms. Hardware characterization and decoding benchmarks using circuit-level simulated syndromes yield a submillisecond post-exposure processing latency for selected small-code workloads ($d = 3, 5, 7$). By enabling logical blocks to be decoded before full-frame readout is complete, the architecture implements low-latency syndrome decoding, realizing real-time quantum information processing as required for fault-tolerant computation in atom arrays.

summaries.en: The paper presents a heterogeneous FPGA–GPU architecture for neutral-atom real-time quantum error correction that overlaps fluorescence acquisition with syndrome decoding at different spatial scales, enabling sub-millisecond post-exposure processing latency and low-latency logical-block decoding before full-frame readout completes.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种用于中性原子实时量子纠错的异构FPGA–GPU架构，通过在不同空间尺度上重叠荧光采集与综合征解码，实现逻辑块在完成全帧读出之前即可提前解码，并在选定的小码（d=3,5,7）工作负载下获得亚毫秒级的后曝光处理延迟。

title: Device-independent witnesses of genuine multipartite entanglement and nonlocality for GHZ states and Bell-pair tree
abstract: We derive and compare device-independent witnesses of genuine multipartite entanglement (GME) and genuine multipartite nonlocality (GMNL) for GHZ states and trees of Bell pairs. A binary-outcome family using four global measurement contexts has the tight biseparable bound independent of the number of parties. We distinguish these GME bounds from Svetlichny-hybrid bounds, which permit arbitrary communication within either side of a bipartition. For GHZ states, we also give a $2N$-context GMNL witness and compare it with MABK and Svetlichny tests. For Bell-pair trees, sums of CHSH and chained inequalities certify GME and GMNL, respectively, with explicitly specified input protocols and multi-bit local outputs. Separately, we prove the sharp four-context network bound $I_\lambda\leq2$ for every $N\geq3$ and $\lambda\geq2$, and bound the MABK scores of quantum networks assembled from bipartite sources. We successfully benchmark MABK, four-context, and Svetlichny witnesses on IBM Quantum GHZ preparations up to $10$ parties, under the local-measurement and sampling assumptions.

summaries.en: The paper derives device-independent witnesses for genuine multipartite entanglement and genuine multipartite nonlocality for GHZ states and Bell-pair trees, including tight bounds and network limits, and experimentally benchmarks several of these witnesses on IBM Quantum up to 10 parties.
summaries.zh: 本文为GHZ态与贝尔对树推导了器件无关的真多体纠缠与真多体非局域性见证方法，给出紧致边界及网络性能上界，并在IBM Quantum上对最多10个粒子的制备结果进行了实验基准测试。

title: A Unified Benchmarking Study of Variational Quantum Eigensolver Ansatz for Electronic Structure Problems
abstract: Electronic structure calculations become computationally expensive on classical computers as electron correlation increases. Quantum computing offers a promising alternative through hybrid quantum-classical Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) on Noisy-Intermediate Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices. The choice of ansatz plays a pivotal role in the performance and scalability of the VQE, yet selecting an optimal ansatz remains challenging. Existing approaches including chemically inspired ansatz, adaptive schemes and Hardware Efficient Ansätze (HEA) lack a unified comparison. This gap makes the scalability and trade-offs of each method unclear for varying molecular sizes. This work presents a systematic benchmarking study comparing Unitary Couples Cluster Singles and Doubles Ansatz (UCCSD), fermionic ADAPT-VQE, BasicPCA HEA, and Excitation Preserving HEA across molecules of varying size like $H_2$, $LiH$, $N_2$. We evaluate trade-offs among circuit depth, parameter count, ground-state energy error, and NISQ feasibility. ADAPT-VQE achieves accuracy comparable to UCCSD with lower resource overhead, but becomes impractical for modest system sizes ($\sim$10 electrons) due to increasing circuit complexity. In contrast, HEA reduces hardware costs but requires more parameters and sacrifices accuracy, with performance strongly dependent on molecular size. The Excitation Preserving ansatz remains below chemical accuracy for $H_2$ and $LiH$, and fails for $N_2$, underscoring the need to balance expressibility and trainability. Overall, these results highlight key trade-offs between accuracy and resource efficiency across VQE ansätze, emphasizing the need to improve ADAPT-VQE scalability and HEA accuracy while addressing optimization challenges for near-term quantum hardware.

summaries.en: The paper presents a systematic benchmark of several VQE ansätze for electronic structure (UCCSD, ADAPT-VQE, BasicPCA HEA, and Excitation Preserving HEA) across molecules of increasing size, comparing circuit depth, parameter counts, energy errors, and NISQ feasibility to reveal trade-offs in accuracy versus resource efficiency and identify ADAPT-VQE’s scaling limits and HEA’s size-dependent accuracy issues.
summaries.zh: 本文对多种用于电子结构计算的变分量子本征求解（VQE）算符组态（UCCSD、ADAPT-VQE、BasicPCA HEA和Excitation Preserving HEA）在不同分子规模下进行系统基准测试，比较电路深度、参数数量、能量误差与NISQ可实现性，揭示准确性与资源效率之间的权衡，并指出ADAPT-VQE的扩展瓶颈以及HEA的尺寸相关准确度问题。

title: Large-scale characterisation of silicon T centres with tuning-free broadband cavities
abstract: T centres in silicon combine an optical transition in the telecom O-band with a long-lived electron and nuclear spin in a photonics- and CMOS-compatible host. However, weak emission of photons in the zero-phonon line (ZPL) makes measurements slow. Cavities can increase the ZPL photon emission, but high-Q cavities require individual tuning to the T centre wavelength, hindering statistical understanding of T centre properties. Here, we overcome this limitation by developing low-Q confocally-addressable cavities. We create an array of 400 cavities, detuned $0.0\pm 1.1$ nm from the T centre, with an average quality factor of $298\pm 78$. The combination of high accuracy and moderate quality factors removes the need for individual tuning. The array yields a median T centre signal increase of $6.5\times$, corresponding to a $42\times$ measurement speedup. Studying the cavity statistics enables new measurements: comparing to a Monte Carlo simulation we infer a T centre density in the sample of $4.2^{+1.3}_{-0.8}~\mathrm{\mu m^{-2}}$, without relying on an estimate for the setup collection efficiency.

summaries.en: The paper reports a CMOS-compatible array of 400 low-Q, detuned confocally addressable broadband cavities that enhance silicon T-centre ZPL emission without individual tuning, enabling faster statistical characterization and yielding an inferred T-centre density of 4.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种用于表征硅中T中心的CMOS兼容400个低Q、失谐且可共聚焦定址的宽带腔阵列，无需对单个T中心逐一调谐即可增强其ZPL发射，从而实现更快的统计表征并在不依赖集光效率估计的情况下推断样品中T中心密度为4.

title: Extractable Work from Collective Dark-State Charging of Quantum Batteries
abstract: We consider two ensembles of superconducting qubits coupled to a common lossy resonator, one serving as the charger and the other the battery. Destructive interference between their collective decay amplitudes selects a tunable family of many-body dark states, allowing controlled excitation transfer from the charger to the battery. The collective charging dynamics preserves the symmetric Dicke subspace of the battery, so its reduced state has at most $N+1$ nonzero eigenvalues. Together with the $N$-fold degeneracy of the battery's first excited energy level, this restriction keeps the passive energy of the entire battery below the single-qubit excitation energy $\omega_0$, independently of the battery size. When the average stored energy per battery qubit is fixed and nonzero, the total stored energy grows linearly with $N$, while the ratio of global ergotropy to stored energy approaches unity as $N$ increases.

summaries.en: By coupling a charging and a battery ensemble of superconducting qubits to a common lossy resonator, the paper uses interference-induced collective dark states to transfer excitations while restricting the battery’s state to the symmetric Dicke subspace so that its passive energy stays below the single-qubit gap regardless of battery size and the global ergotropy becomes asymptotically equal to stored energy for large N.
summaries.zh: 该论文通过将充电与电池两组超导量子比特耦合到同一个有损谐振器，利用干涉诱导的集体暗态实现可控的激发转移，并由于电池态被限制在对称狄克子空间中，其被动能量始终低于单量子比特能隙且不随电池尺寸增长；在固定且非零的单比特平均储能下，总储能随 N 线性增长，而随 N 增大全局强特罗皮（global ergotropy）与储能之比趋近于 1。

title: The infrared vacuum reduces the laser energy needed to break molecular bonds of simple molecules
abstract: Vibrational strong coupling within a few molecules has recently been demonstrated in infrared nanocavities at room temperature, opening new alternatives to explore chemical reactions assisted by the confined electromagnetic vacuum. However, the intrinsic mechanisms of how the quantized electromagnetic mode modifies reactivity are not fully understood. We study infrared photodissociation of a single molecule strongly coupled to a resonant infrared nanocavity mode. The coupled system is driven by a monochromatic infrared laser that vibrationally excites the molecule directly or injects photons into the nanocavity field. We compare the intracavity dynamics of CO2 and H2O molecules and demonstrate that the driving energy required for dissociation is up to three orders of magnitude lower inside the cavity by injecting photons into the nanocavity than by driving the molecule directly. We show that photodissociation enhancements are due to the interplay between nuclear anharmonicity, stronglight-mattercoupling, and vacuum field polarisation according to the dipolar nature of the molecular bond. Our results provide the conceptual and numerical tools for understanding how to control chemical processes and to design nanophotonics experiments at the few-molecule level within a cavity quantum electrodynamics perspective.

summaries.en: This study shows that for a single molecule (CO2 or H2O) strongly coupled to an infrared nanocavity, injecting photons into the cavity can reduce the laser energy needed for photodissociation by up to three orders of magnitude, attributed to the combined effects of nuclear anharmonicity, strong light–matter coupling, and vacuum-field polarization of the dipolar molecular bond.
summaries.zh: 该研究表明，对于与红外纳米腔发生强耦合的单个分子（CO2或H2O），将光子注入纳米腔可使光解所需的激光能量降低高达三个数量级，其原因来自核非谐性、强光-物质耦合以及与分子键偶极性质相关的真空场极化的共同作用。

title: Restoring Heisenberg Scaling in Hamiltonian Estimation despite Noise Uncertainty
abstract: Noise degrades quantum coherence and limits the precision of quantum sensors. Quantum control can counteract these effects, but existing strategies typically assume that the noise is known. In practice, noise is often only partially characterized, so its parameters must be estimated jointly with the Hamiltonian parameters of interest. Here we show that uncertainty in the noise parameters can destroy otherwise attainable Heisenberg scaling, even when coherence is preserved. For general Markovian dynamics under arbitrary quantum control, we derive a necessary and sufficient condition for each Hamiltonian parameter to retain this scaling and determine its optimal asymptotic precision when the condition holds. When the condition fails, we propose a protocol that uses a suitable noisy reference system to restore this scaling, and prove that a reference insensitive to the Hamiltonian parameters but subject to an independent copy of the sensor's noise recovers the optimal precision attainable with known noise. Our results reveal how incomplete knowledge of the noise affects the fundamental limits of quantum metrology, with broad implications for achieving quantum-enhanced precision in realistic environments.

summaries.en: The paper analyzes Hamiltonian parameter estimation under general Markovian noise with arbitrary quantum control, proving when unknown noise parameters will or will not preserve Heisenberg scaling and providing an explicit reference-system protocol to restore the optimal scaling when this condition fails despite noise uncertainty.
summaries.zh: 本文研究在一般马尔可夫噪声与任意量子控制下的哈密顿量参数估计，证明在噪声参数未知时何时仍能保持海森堡标度并给出一种当条件失效时利用合适参考系统恢复该标度、进而在噪声不确定下达到已知噪声时的最优精度的协议。

title: Defect-induced stabilization of Wigner negativity and parity-protected phase-locking
abstract: We show that a parity-preserving delta-shaped potential, mimicking the presence of a localized defect, reduces the continuous $U(1)$-symmetry of a quantum van der Pol oscillator to the discrete $\mathbb{Z}_2$-symmetry. This mechanism guarantees protected even-parity stationary quantum coherences, resulting in the generation of non-classical steady-states characterized by Wigner function negativity. Thanks to a non-trivial interplay between the defect and non-linear dissipative channels, this kind of negativity entails parity-protected quantum phase locking, meaning that the oscillator's energy levels simultaneously lock into two opposite phases. Finally, we present a realistic experimental proposal involving the motional state of ultracold alkaline-earth-like atoms in optical tweezers, where the localized defect is engineered via state-selective contact interactions, while the non-linear dissipative channels are driven by Raman sidebands.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Statistical Mechanics (cond-mat.stat-mech)

summaries.en: The paper shows that a parity-preserving defect-like delta potential reduces a quantum van der Pol oscillator’s U(1) symmetry to Z2, stabilizing even-parity quantum coherences and producing steady states with Wigner-function negativity that further enables parity-protected phase locking of energy levels, with an experimental proposal using trapped ultracold alkaline-earth-like atoms and engineered defect and nonlinear dissipative Raman processes.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，保持宇称的类似缺陷的δ形势会将量子范德波尔振荡器的连续U(1)对称性降为离散的Z2，从而稳定偶宇称量子相干并生成具有Wigner函数负性的非经典稳态，且由于缺陷与非线性耗散通道的非平凡耦合，这种负性还能实现宇称保护的相位锁定（能级同时锁定到相反相位），并提出了使用光镊中超冷碱土金属样原子、通过态选择性接触相互作用实现局域缺陷并用拉曼边带驱动非线性耗散的实验方案。

title: Enhanced Entanglement Gate Fidelity via Correlated and Synchronized Atom Motion
abstract: Engineered collective dissipation can correlate and even synchronize the motion of quantum systems. We show that such motional correlations can suppress motion-induced errors in two-qubit controlled-phase gates based on the Rydberg blockade in neutral-atom tweezer arrays. To leading order in the Lamb-Dicke parameter, the motional contribution to the gate infidelity is determined solely by the two-atom motional occupations and correlations, and is independent of the gate protocol. We illustrate this result for correlated thermal states and synchronized quantum van der Pol oscillators. In each case, motional correlations reduce the gate infidelity relative to independent thermal atoms at finite temperature. Our results establish atomic-motion correlations as a resource for high-fidelity neutral-atom gates and may also find applications in analog quantum simulators.

summaries.en: The paper shows that correlated and synchronized neutral-atom motion produced by engineered collective dissipation can suppress motion-induced errors in Rydberg-blockade controlled-phase gates, with the leading-order gate infidelity depending only on two-atom motional occupations and correlations (not the protocol), demonstrated for correlated thermal states and synchronized quantum van der Pol oscillators where such correlations reduce infidelity at finite temperature.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，通过工程化的集体耗散产生的相关与同步的中性原子运动，能够抑制基于里德伯阻塞的受控相位门中的运动诱导误差；在以兰姆-迪克参数为主的近似下，门保真度损失的主导项只由两原子的运动占据与关联决定，而与具体门协议无关，并通过相关热态和同步的量子范德波耳振子得到验证，在有限温度下运动关联相较独立热原子可降低门失真。

title: Revealing Bell Nonlocality Does Not Require the Same Physical Measurement to be Performed Twice
abstract: Bell inequality violations, or Bell nonlocality for short, is not only central to testing the foundations of quantum physics but have also become an essential ingredient of numerous quantum information protocols, from quantum key distribution to the device-independent certification of randomness and secure communication. Existing analyses of Bell nonlocality assume that a small set of predefined measurement directions can be reproduced exactly. But what if these directions cannot be reproduced at all? This may happen for fundamental or technical reasons, such as variations in the measurement apparatus. Here we show that the violation of a Bell inequality remains possible and that it also retains its operational significance, even when the measurement directions never repeat. We experimentally confirm these results using polarization-entangled photons, detecting only one particle pair per randomly chosen analyzer direction. Our results establish the robustness of Bell inequality violations against imperfect measurement repeatability and further connect Bell tests with the broader framework of randomized measurements. Moreover, they extend quantum information protocols to settings with limited measurement control, including quantum device certification, communication complexity, and quantum cryptography.

summaries.en: The paper experimentally and theoretically shows that Bell inequality violations remain possible and operationally meaningful even when the measurement directions never repeat exactly, thereby establishing robustness against imperfect measurement repeatability and extending implications for randomized measurements and quantum information protocols like device-independent certification, communication complexity, and quantum cryptography.
summaries.zh: 本文通过理论与实验表明，即便测量方向从不精确重复，贝尔不等式仍可能被违反且具有实际操作意义，从而证明其对测量重复性不完善的鲁棒性，并将相关结论拓展到随机测量框架以及器件无关认证、通信复杂度和量子密码等量子信息协议。

title: Superradiant photon bunching in nanolasers: from a polarization-order hierarchy of the master equation to Dicke Markov chains
abstract: In nanolasers, a few to a few hundred quantum emitters share a single mode of light. Coupled identically to the mode, the emitters do not radiate independently but form collective bright and dark states, producing superradiant bursts and strongly bunched photon statistics below the laser threshold. We investigate to what extent this behavior can be understood as random jumps between collective Dicke states. From the laser master equation, we derive a hierarchy of models defined by the polarization order, i.e., the number of photons involved in the coherence between the emitters and the light, and include the coherence to various orders. With all of the coherences eliminated, we obtain a Dicke Markov chain, a stochastic jump process over the photon number and the Dicke states, in which collective effects enter only through enhanced or suppressed transition rates. It predicts superthermal bunching and a strong even--odd dependence on the emitter number. It recovers about 80\% of the bunching in the most coherent regime, where conventional rate equations predict no superthermal bunching. Keeping the first polarization order, i.e., the optical polarization, and eliminating the second order, i.e., the two-photon coherences, yields a population-polarization model, which recovers the bunching of the full master equation almost perfectly. This hierarchy of polarization orders is an alternative to the cumulant expansion and, unlike it, recovers the master equation at the highest order. As a numerically exact reference, a symmetry-reduced master equation extends the simulation range all the way to 34 (24) emitters below (above) threshold. The Dicke Markov chain can be solved directly for hundreds of emitters and sampled for thousands of emitters, further extending the range of numerical methods. We compare the numerical performance of the methods in detail to guide the choice of technique.

summaries.en: The paper derives a hierarchy of polarization-order reduced models from the nanolaser master equation, culminating in a Dicke Markov chain of stochastic jumps between collective Dicke states that explains superradiant photon bunching below threshold and accurately reproduces master-equation bunching while enabling simulations for up to dozens of emitters exactly and thousands approximately.
