summaries.zh: 本文从纳米激光的主方程出发按“极化阶次”（参与发射体与光的相干所含光子数）建立一系列约化模型，最终得到在集体Dicke态之间随机跳跃的Dicke马尔可夫链，用以解释阈值以下的超辐射光子聚束并在一定阶次上几乎完美再现主方程结果，同时将精确数值模拟扩展到数十个发射体、近似采样扩展到上千个发射体并对不同方法的数值性能作出比较。

title: Comprehensive quantum electrodynamics of fast electrons interacting with dissipative nanostructures and quantum light
abstract: Theoretical descriptions of the quantum electrodynamical interaction between fast electrons and nanostructures conventionally rely on standard macroscopic quantum electrodynamics (MQED), which, when applied to bounded objects in vacuum, formally requires an asymptotic limiting procedure to account for free-space radiation modes. To explicitly incorporate these modes from the outset, we employ the modified Langevin noise formalism (MLNF), which independently quantizes both the asymptotic scattering modes and the electromagnetic field generated by dissipative material sources. Utilizing an exact second-order Magnus expansion, we derive a closed-form, nonperturbative master formula for the transverse-momentum-resolved energy exchange probability. In the unilluminated regime, we demonstrate that at finite nanostructure temperatures, the vacuum scattering and thermal material fluctuations do not mathematically recombine into the total imaginary part of the dyadic Green's function. This breakdown does not violate the Fluctuation-Dissipation Theorem, because the explicit zero-temperature scattering field acts as an independent dynamical system that maintains the configuration out of global thermodynamic equilibrium. This fundamental separation reveals an intrinsic Stokes--Anti-Stokes asymmetry, yielding distinct transverse diffraction patterns for energy loss and thermal energy gain, and establishing a generalized detailed-balance relation that governs the radiative reduction of the apparent temperature in nanoscale electron thermometry. In the illuminated regime, our framework rigorously incorporates quantum-optical states into macroscopic dissipative electrodynamics, demonstrating that...
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall); Optics (physics.optics)

summaries.en: The paper develops a nonperturbative quantum-electrodynamics framework for fast electrons interacting with dissipative nanostructures and quantum light by using the modified Langevin noise formalism to quantize both free-space scattering modes and material-emitted fields, deriving a closed-form master formula for transverse-momentum-resolved energy exchange and showing an intrinsic Stokes–Anti-Stokes asymmetry with a generalized detailed-balance relation for nanoscale electron thermometry in the unilluminated regime, while extending the method to include quantum-optical states in the illuminated regime.
summaries.zh: 论文通过使用修正朗之万噪声形式从一开始独立量子化自由空间散射模与材料源产生的电磁场，建立了快电子与耗散纳结构及量子光相互作用的非微扰量子电动力学框架，并推导出横向动量分辨的能量交换的闭式主方程；在未照明情形下，作者证明真空散射与有限温度材料涨落不会数学上合并为二极矢格林函数的总虚部，从而产生本征的斯托克斯–反斯托克斯不对称性，并给出支配纳尺度电子测温中辐射性“表观温度降低”的广义详细平衡关系，同时在照明情形下将量子光态严格并入宏观耗散电动力学。

title: The importance of shear strain in narrow Si/SiGe quantum wells
abstract: Several heterostructure profiles have been proposed for Si/SiGe quantum wells, to improve the operation of quantum-dot spin qubits. These structures share a common goal of generating either of the two wave vectors that govern the conduction-band valley coupling, dubbed $k_0$ and $k_1$. Here, we focus on the long-wavelength $k_1$ term that couples valleys when paired with shear strain, and which governs the Dresselhaus spin-orbit coupling. We show that shear strain induced by metal top gates may be enough to activate the $k_1$ valley-coupling mechanism, mitigating the need for "ultrasharp" interfaces, as commonly assumed for large valley energy splittings. We propose a scheme featuring narrow quantum wells that does not require ultrasharp interfaces, but should still provide large deterministic valley splittings (when paired with shear strain), and large spin-orbit couplings and $g$-factor corrections, which are of great interest for experimental implementations.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall)

summaries.en: The paper shows that shear strain from metal top gates can activate the long-wavelength k1 valley-coupling mechanism in narrow Si/SiGe quantum wells—thereby enabling large deterministic valley splittings and enhanced spin-orbit effects without requiring ultrasharp interfaces for quantum-dot spin qubits.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，金属顶栅引入的剪切应变可在窄Si/SiGe量子阱中激活长波长k1能谷耦合机制，从而在不依赖“超陡”界面的情况下仍获得大的确定性能谷分裂，并增强自旋轨道效应，服务于量子点自旋量子比特。

title: Phase Interference and Transverse Catalysts Govern the Noise Fragility of Long-Range Variational Quantum Circuits
abstract: Long-range entangling gates shorten variational state preparation, but they also accelerate operator spreading across the register, linking nonlocality to a presumed noise fragility. Here we show that the single-fault fragility $F$ of a variational circuit is governed by how fault phases interfere on the target Hamiltonian, not by how far faults spread. For Heisenberg chains we prove that two faults with identical extensive support can incur either bounded or extensive energy damage, in the exact ratio $N/2$. A phase-matched longitudinal halo remains energetically dark until ignited by transverse catalysts that break a symmetry of the remote register, namely spatially nonuniform single-qubit rotations or the pair-flip component of two-qubit $XX/YY$ gates, whereas uniform rotations and magnetization-conserving exchange gates leave it strictly dark. In noisy training with full-width long-range $ZZ$ gates, suppressing either catalyst alone leaves circuits trapped on an ignited plateau sustained by remote $XY$ couplings, whereas suppressing both eliminates the plateau, achieves minimal fragility despite larger fault operators, and halves the dephasing error. Training is driven by a race between catalyst pruning and gradient force balance, as annealing the transverse catalysts out of trapped circuits rescues every trajectory while annealing the entire longitudinal sector does not. Combined with the gate-count exposure $\lambda=pK$, a single fragility measurement accurately predicts the noise-induced energy shift across circuit architectures and noise strengths, reducing ansatz design to a trade-off between coherent expressivity and gate count.

summaries.en: The paper shows that in long-range variational quantum circuits the single-fault noise fragility is determined by how fault phases interfere on the target Hamiltonian (including exact N/2 scaling and symmetry-dependent “energetically dark” longitudinal components) and by transverse catalyst terms that can ignite or suppress a noise-induced plateau during noisy training, enabling a single fragility measurement to predict energy shifts across architectures while turning ansatz design into a coherent expressivity–gate-count trade-off.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，在使用长程纠缠门的变分量子电路中，单一故障的噪声脆弱性由故障相位在目标哈密顿量上的干涉方式决定（包括精确的 N/2 缩放以及对称性所致的“能量暗态”纵向分量），并受能在噪声训练中点燃或抑制噪声诱导平台的横向催化项影响，从而可用一次脆弱性测量预测不同电路结构与噪声强度下的能量偏移，并将本体（ansatz）设计简化为相干表达能力与门数之间的权衡。

title: Quantum Control
abstract: Quantum Control is the art of steering the fragile dynamics of a quantum system in a precise way toward a desired final state or transformation. It is a cornerstone of many quantum technology applications and at the same time allows us to shed light on the fundamental connection between the energy structure and the time dynamics of quantum systems at the heart of some of the most interesting phenomena of quantum mechanics. In this chapter on quantum control, we introduce the control problem, go through basic error sources and methods to suppress these errors and then discuss state-of-the-art techniques to solve the control problem, like adiabatic methods, quantum optimal control and methods of machine learning.

summaries.en: The paper surveys quantum control by defining the control problem, explaining common error sources and their mitigation, and presenting modern methods such as adiabatic techniques, quantum optimal control, and machine-learning approaches while linking control dynamics to the energy structure of quantum systems.
summaries.zh: 本文概述量子控制：界定控制问题，说明常见误差来源及其抑制方法，并介绍如绝热方法、量子最优控制与机器学习等前沿技术，同时揭示量子系统能量结构与时间动力学之间的内在联系。

title: Infinite or indefinite: the query cost of simulating the quantum switch
abstract: The quantum switch applies two operations in a coherent superposition of their causal orders and is a simple example of indefinite causal order. No quantum circuit that uses each operation once in a definite order can even describe it, yet photonic experiments have demonstrated its physical realization. We ask how many calls to the black-box operations a quantum computer in the circuit model needs to reproduce the switch. If one of the black boxes is known to be unitary, three calls suffice. For general channels on a $d$-dimensional system, we prove three results. In all three, circuits may use classical feed-forward and unlimited ancillary quantum memory. First, no finite number of calls suffices for exact simulation in the worst case. Second, approximation to any fixed error below $1/2$, measured in half the diamond norm, requires $\Omega(d^{1/4})$ calls, exponential in the number of qubits. Third, an ordinary circuit can require exponentially many calls to obtain a single bit that the switch extracts with a few uses. We consider a device whose actual noise is dephasing in a fixed unknown basis and test it against a theoretical depolarizing model. The two channels have the same entanglement and average gate fidelities, so these figures alone do not distinguish them. At fixed noise strength, the quantum switch tells them apart with a number of device uses independent of $d$, whereas the circuit model requires $\Omega(d^{1/16})$ calls. Noise characterization is needed for quantum error correction, and this gives a provable query advantage of the switch in a task relevant to practical quantum computing. We invite future work that extends such advantages to more practical computing tasks.

summaries.en: The paper analyzes the circuit-model query complexity of simulating the quantum switch and shows that exact worst-case simulation is impossible with any finite number of black-box calls, that achieving constant-accuracy approximation requires at least Ω(d^{1/4}) calls (and thus exponential in qubit count), that some circuit outputs require exponentially many calls, and that even when a dephasing device is matched to a depolarizing model by standard fidelity measures, the quantum switch can distinguish them with dimension-independent uses while circuits need Ω(d^{1/16}) queries.
summaries.zh: 本文研究在电路模型下用黑箱调用来模拟量子开关的查询复杂度，证明最坏情况下精确模拟需要的黑箱调用次数不可能是有限值；而将误差压到任意小于1/2的固定水平（以半diamond范数度量）至少需 Ω(d^{1/4}) 次调用（随量子比特数呈指数级），并且某些电路要提取量子开关所含信息中的单个比特还需指数级调用；同时即使用纠缠与平均门保真度把实际的固定未知基的去相位噪声设备与理论去极化模型匹配，这些保真度也无法区分两者，而量子开关能在与维数无关的设备使用次数内区分它们，而电路模型仍需 Ω(d^{1/16}) 次查询，从而给出与实际量子计算相关的可证明优势。

title: Hierarchical Decoding for Quantum Error Correction
abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computing requires classical decoders that can keep up with syndrome data streams and supply correction information and logical measurement outcomes to the quantum control system. Meeting these requirements at scale requires high throughput while controlling the end-to-end latency from readout to usable correction. In this paper, we organize decoding algorithms, execution strategies, and code constructions using common classifications and examine their performance and trade-offs under the reported evaluation conditions. We distinguish decoder-level hierarchy, where multiple decoding stages or resources cooperate to decode a single code, from code-level hierarchy, where the code construction itself introduces multiple decoding levels. We first review single-code hierarchical decoders and their cascaded predecoding and windowed, streaming, and distributed implementations. We then study hierarchical and concatenated codes, focusing on how decoding is coordinated across code levels through hard decisions, soft reliability information, or syndrome information. We also examine how qubit modalities shape decoding workloads and timing requirements, and review how different decoding platforms meet these requirements, including central processing units (CPUs), graphics processing units (GPUs), field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs), application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs), and cryogenic platforms. By assessing design trade-offs, this paper clarifies connections across the literature and provides a shared foundation for QEC design exploration. It also identifies gaps in performance reporting and system integration to guide future research toward practical quantum error correction.

summaries.en: The paper surveys and compares hierarchical decoding strategies for quantum error correction—covering decoder-level and code-level hierarchy, cascaded and streaming/distributed implementations, and coordination methods across concatenated codes—then analyzes how different qubit modalities and hardware platforms (CPU/GPU/FPGA/ASIC/cryogenic) affect throughput and end-to-end latency, highlighting reporting/integration gaps to guide future practical QEC system design.
summaries.zh: 本文对量子误差校正中的分层解码策略进行综述与比较，涵盖解码层级与码层级、级联以及窗口化/流式/分布式实现，并研究在级联编码中跨不同层级的协调方式；同时分析不同量子比特模态及CPU/GPU/FPGA/ASIC/低温平台对吞吐量与从读出到可用校正的端到端时延的影响，指出性能报告与系统集成方面的不足以指导未来走向可实践的QEC系统设计。

title: Circuit-Level Analysis of Quantum Error Correction in Second-Generation Quantum Repeaters
abstract: We present a circuit-level simulation of second-generation quantum repeaters with stabilizer-based quantum error correction. We model a two-segment repeater link including encoding, syndrome extraction, decoding, and entanglement swapping, and compare the performance of the single-error-correcting Steane and five-qubit stabilizer codes under different noise scenarios. To that extent, we consider noise sources with incoherent (depolarizing and dephasing) and coherent (systematic over-rotation) errors and incorporate them directly at the circuit level. While the Steane code outperforms the five-qubit code at coherent errors, the five-qubit code achieves higher end-to-end fidelities under incoherent noise in the low-noise regime when a large number of physical qubits is affected by it. At higher noise regimes, employing no code turns out to be the best option. In mixed noise scenarios, we observe moderate cross-effects between the noise classes regarding the error correction performance. We conclude that code selection in second-generation quantum repeaters must be adapted to the dominant physical noise mechanism and that circuit complexity and hardware-aware implementation options influence performance in coherent-error-dominated regimes, providing design insights for error correction in quantum repeaters.

summaries.en: The paper presents circuit-level simulations of second-generation quantum repeater links with stabilizer-based quantum error correction, comparing Steane and five-qubit codes under incoherent (depolarizing/dephasing) and coherent (systematic over-rotation) noise and finding that Steane better handles coherent errors, five-qubit can yield higher fidelity for incoherent low-noise regimes with many affected qubits, unencoded transmission may be optimal at high noise, and code choice should be matched to the dominant noise source with circuit complexity and hardware-aware implementation affecting coherent-error performance.
summaries.zh: 本文对第二代量子中继链路进行基于稳定子测量的电路级误差校正电路仿真，比较了在非相干噪声（退极化/去相干）与相干噪声（系统性过旋转）下 Steane 码与五体稳定子码的性能，并发现：Steane 码在相干误差下更优，五体码在低噪声且被影响的物理量子比特数量较多的非相干噪声情形下可获得更高端到端保真度，高噪声区不加编码反而最佳，混合噪声下两类噪声对误差校正表现有中等交互效应，因而第二代量子中继中的码选择应随主导噪声机制调整，且电路复杂度与面向硬件的实现方式会影响相干误差主导场景的性能，从而给出设计启示。

title: Symmetry and quasi-gauge invariance of Krylov complexity
abstract: Krylov spread complexity quantifies how extensively a quantum system explores its Hilbert space during time evolution. We identify two classes of unitary transformations that preserve the complexity of the associated dynamics, and relate this property to the invariance of the energy distribution of the initial state and of its associated Hamiltonian moments. These transformations are either symmetry operator of the Hamiltonian, or local $U(1)$ transformations of which the initial state is an eigenstate. The latter naturally arise as quasi-gauge transformations in chiral continuous-time quantum walks, to which the invariance properties are applied. We show that chiral phases in circulant Hamiltonians generically lift spectral degeneracies, leading to a discontinuous change in the long-time-averaged complexity. For a localized initial states and a nondegenerate spectrum, complexity is $\bar{C}=(D-1)/2$, where $D$ is the Hilbert-space dimension, independently of the degree of connectivity. A non-circulant quantum router illustrates the additional role of phase-dependent spectral weights. These examples show that Krylov complexity can change even when probability time-reversal symmetry is preserved, linking its response to chirality to spectral changes rather than directly to transport asymmetry.

summaries.en: The paper shows which unitary transformations—including Hamiltonian symmetries and certain quasi-gauge local U(1) phases tied to eigenstates—preserve Krylov spread complexity, links this invariance to the initial energy distribution and Hamiltonian moments, and demonstrates that chiral phases can lift spectral degeneracies and cause discontinuous jumps in long-time-averaged complexity even when probability time-reversal symmetry remains intact, with the localized nondegenerate result  ar{C}=(D-1)/2 independent of connectivity.
summaries.zh: 论文识别出两类保持Krylov展开复杂度不变的幺正变换（包括哈密顿量对称性与与初态为本征态相关的局域U(1)准规范变换），并将不变性与初态能量分布及其对应哈密顿量矩的不变相关起来；此外指出手性相位会在环形哈密顿量中普遍地抬升谱简并，从而导致长时间平均复杂度的跳变，即使仍保持概率时间反演对称，其变化也主要源于谱的改变而非直接的输运非对称，并给出在局域初态且谱非简并条件下 ar{C}=(D-1)/2且与连通度无关的结果。

title: Quantum Mpemba effect from logical-information exposure in monitored circuits
abstract: In the Mpemba effect, a state initially farther from stationarity overtakes one that starts closer. After one cycle in a monitored Clifford chain, an unencoded Bell-pair state has lower mean entanglement entropy than a scrambled reference prepared from fewer pairs. The gap grows linearly with chain length. This reversal is driven by logical-information exposure: a stabilizer state loses one ebit per independent logical parity resolved by the record. Scrambling within each half can spread this information over many sites while preserving every Schmidt coefficient. We prove that with independent exact unitary two-design encoders, any pure reference ensemble with no greater mean initial entropy can lead in mean entropy by at most two ebits at any time. If the stationary entropy is subextensive, the unencoded reversal is a quantum Mpemba effect at large sizes. We further certify this effect at 128 and 256 qubits using stationary-entropy bounds.

summaries.en: The paper shows that in monitored Clifford circuits a quantum Mpemba effect arises where an initially less stationary unencoded Bell-pair state ends up with lower mean entanglement entropy than a more locally prepared scrambled reference, with the entanglement-entropy gap growing linearly with circuit length and explained by logical-information exposure resolving logical parities and reducing entanglement by up to one ebit per parity, while proving limits using two-design encoders and verifying the phenomenon at 128 and 256 qubits via stationary-entropy bounds.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，在受监测的Clifford电路中会出现量子Mpemba效应：一开始离平衡更远的未编码Bell对态在平均纠缠熵上反而会比采用更少对制备的“更接近平衡”的参考混合态更低，且纠缠熵差随链长线性增长，其机制来自对逻辑信息的暴露——记录解析了独立的逻辑奇偶使每个奇偶损失约1个ebit；作者还用两个设计编码器证明了在任意时刻平均纠缠熵的最多提升幅度限制，并在128与256比特上通过平衡纠缠熵界对该效应进行了验证。

title: Effect of atomic interactions on quantum communication protocols
abstract: We develop a first-principles framework for analyzing photonic quantum communication in an atomic medium. Starting from a real-space quantization of the electromagnetic field coupled to an ensemble of two-level atoms, we derive an effective model for polarization-encoded single-photon states. We apply this framework to superdense coding to study communication efficiency and to the BB84 quantum key distribution protocol for communication security. For superdense coding, we evaluate the protocol capacity of the fixed Bell-state alphabet under erasure, dephasing, and depolarizing channels and show that it decreases monotonically with increasing atom-field coupling. For BB84, we formulate a modified protocol that discards erasure outcomes and uses the microscopic model to estimate the intrinsic loss rate. We derive the corresponding asymptotic key rate and show that it decreases monotonically with coupling strength and vanishes beyond a finite critical coupling.

summaries.en: The paper develops a first-principles quantization-based model of polarization-encoded photonic states in an atomic two-level medium and uses it to show that both superdense coding capacity (under erasure/dephasing/depolarizing noise) and BB84 asymptotic key rate decrease monotonically with atom-field coupling, with the BB84 key rate vanishing beyond a finite critical coupling.
summaries.zh: 本文基于对电磁场在原空间量子化并与两能级原子系综耦合的第一性原理建模，研究原子介质中偏振编码单光子的行为，并将该框架用于超密编码与BB84量子密钥分发，结果表明超密编码在擦除/相位扰动/退极化信道下的容量随原子-场耦合强度单调下降，而BB84的渐近密钥率同样随耦合强度单调下降并在超过有限临界耦合后归零。

title: Beauty and charm jet identification with end-to-end training on a superconducting quantum processor
abstract: The identification of heavy-flavor jets, i.e. collimated streams of particles originating from the fragmentation of beauty and charm quarks produced in proton-proton collisions, represents one of the most challenging classification tasks in measurements at Large Hadron Collider experiments. In recent years, advanced machine learning techniques have been successfully employed to address this problem, while quantum machine learning has emerged as a promising alternative approach. However, the high dimensionality of the problem, typically involving hundreds of observables, raises an open question: whether the current generation of quantum computers, characterized by limited qubit count, can effectively tackle such complex tasks. In this work, a variational quantum circuit for the classification of b- and c-jets at the LHCb experiment is implemented on a 5-qubit superconducting quantum computer manufactured by IQM and installed at the Politecnico di Torino. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of a quantum algorithm for jet identification using simulated data from an LHC experiment in which all stages of the machine-learning workflow, including training and testing, are performed on real quantum hardware. The results demonstrate that the impact of hardware-induced quantum noise does not significantly degrade the performance. A framework for the evaluation of the training time on the quantum hardware and for the circuit optimization is also proposed. These findings pave the way for future applications on larger quantum devices based on superconducting qubits, featuring a larger number of qubits enabling the encoding of information beyond the reach of classical simulation and providing a step toward investigating whether quantum advantage may eventually be achievable in high-energy physics classification tasks.

summaries.en: The paper presents, on a 5-qubit superconducting processor, a variational end-to-end quantum algorithm that classifies LHCb beauty and charm jets using simulated LHC data, showing that hardware noise does not markedly reduce performance and outlining tools for circuit optimization and training-time evaluation to support future studies of potential quantum advantage in high-energy physics classification.
summaries.zh: 论文在一台5量子比特的超导量子处理器上提出并实现端到端的变分量子算法，使用LHCb的模拟数据对美/粲（b与c）喷注进行分类，结果表明硬件噪声对性能影响不显著，并给出电路优化与量子硬件训练时间评估框架，为未来更大规模超导量子设备上研究高能物理分类的潜在量子优势奠定基础。

title: Persistent-mediator architecture for universal fault-tolerant quantum computation with color codes
abstract: Two-dimensional color codes provide transversal Clifford gates, whereas suitable three-dimensional codes provide a transversal $T$ gate. Representative cross-dimensional schemes either switch the computational encoding or consume a 3D encoded state. Reusing the same protected 3D block would remove repeated auxiliary-state preparation and terminal readout, raising a central question: can the 3D module remain encoded and protected while mediating successive $T$ gates on a separate 2D register? Here we introduce a cross-dimensional persistent-mediator architecture that retains the 2D data register and 3D mediator as distinct encoded modules at each cycle boundary, coupled only through a transient protected subsystem. We construct a membrane-like joint-logical measurement and combine it with a matched cross-dimensional $CZ$, complementary string-like surgery, and feed-forward to close a deterministic logical $T$-gate cycle. The cycle avoids post-selection and destructive mediator readout and restores the 3D block to its initial logical state. Stabilizer analysis establishes the logical action and preserved spatial distance. Phenomenological and circuit-level simulations of a Clifford surrogate show finite-distance scaling close to the matched 3D memory benchmark, while sequential tests show approximately linear logical-error accumulation in the low-error regime. Persistent mediation enables repeated access to higher-dimensional non-Clifford capability while keeping the computational register in its 2D encoding.

summaries.en: The paper presents a cross-dimensional persistent-mediator architecture that repeatedly applies fault-tolerant logical T gates by coupling a protected 3D color-code mediator to a separate 2D color-code data register through transient measurements, enabling deterministic, non-postselected cycles that restore the 3D block’s state and achieve near matched-memory performance with roughly linear error accumulation at low error rates.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种跨维持久中介架构，通过将受保护的3D彩色码中介态与独立的2D彩色码数据寄存器在瞬时测量子系统中耦合，反复实现容错的逻辑T门，并在不依赖后选择且不破坏中介读出的条件下完成确定性门循环，同时将3D模块恢复到初始逻辑态、稳定子分析保证正确的逻辑作用与空间距离，仿真结果显示随距离的有限距离缩放接近匹配的3D存储基准且在低误差区间逻辑误差随序列近似线性累积。

title: Inter-city 18.9 km free-space QKD over a dense urban corridor
abstract: Terrestrial free-space quantum key distribution (QKD) provides a flexible complement to fiber-based networks, but its deployment over long horizontal paths in dense metropolitan environments remains challenging, as atmospheric turbulence, demanding pointing and tracking requirements, and operational constraints can substantially increase system complexity. We experimentally demonstrate the operation of a decoy-state BB84 system over an 18.9~km free-space link across a densely populated urban area in the metropolitan region of Barcelona using an aviation-compliant optical architecture. The system operates at 785~nm using room-temperature single-photon detectors and requires no adaptive optics at the receiver. The modular QKD transmitter, based on a deployment-oriented design, is interfaced with a versatile free-space optical terminal and an independent GPS-disciplined synchronization architecture, facilitating its integration into heterogeneous optical infrastructures. We present the transmitter performance and optical-link characteristics, together with a 40-minute field test characterized by an average channel attenuation of approximately 19~dB and a mean QBER of 1.31\%. From the measured channel parameters, we estimate an average finite-size secret key rate exceeding 11~kbit/s. These results demonstrate the feasibility of inter-city free-space QKD over dense urban areas using a comparatively simple architecture.

summaries.en: The paper experimentally demonstrates an aviation-compliant, receiver-simple decoy-state BB84 free-space QKD system operating at 785 nm over an 18.
summaries.zh: 论文在巴塞罗那密集城市环境中实现了18.

title: Non-Convex Optimization via Quantum Tunneling Search on a Photonic Chip
abstract: Non-convex optimization plays an important role in modern machine learning since plenty of real-world problems have objective functions or constraints with non-convex properties. The non-convex nature of landscapes gives rise to numerous local minima and saddle points, dramatically hindering the ability of gradient descent-based methods to explore the landscape and obtain global optima. Here we present quantum tunneling search (QTS), an algorithm based on quantum tunneling walk and local annealing, which effectively explores the non-convex landscape by leveraging the quantum tunneling effect. In experiments, we map an objective function to the potential term of the waveguide Hamiltonian by controlling the refractive index with the femtosecond direct laser writing technique. With a proper input state, the average probability distributions on 10-micrometer-spaced 29 x 1 and 21 x 9 waveguide arrays highlight the local minima of various 1D and 2D non-convex landscapes, respectively. By further introducing the varying Hamiltonian approach, more efficient search and even the identification of the global minimum are achieved. Our work experimentally verifies that QTS is a successful and efficient non-convex optimization solver, demonstrating quantum speedups over classical stochastic gradient descent (SGD), which serves as a practical application of near-term analog quantum simulators in the field of machine learning.

summaries.en: The paper presents quantum tunneling search (QTS), implemented on a photonic chip by encoding the optimization objective into a waveguide Hamiltonian via femtosecond laser-written refractive index patterns, and experimentally shows it can efficiently explore non-convex landscapes, locate local minima (and sometimes the global minimum), and outperform classical stochastic gradient descent via quantum speedups.
summaries.zh: 论文提出量子隧穿搜索（QTS），通过用飞秒直写技术调控波导折射率将优化目标编码进波导哈密顿量，并在光子芯片上实现，实验结果表明其能高效探索非凸景观、识别局部极小值（甚至有时找到全局最小值），相较经典随机梯度下降表现出量子加速。

title: Hong$-$Ou$-$Mandel-like interference between two independent narrowband thermal states
abstract: Narrowband photonic sources are promising candidates in quantum networks for a direct interface with atomic quantum memories. However, building a large-scale quantum network requires many indistinguishable sources, and matching the frequencies of independent narrowband sources is generally challenging. Here, we propose a method to measure the frequency difference between two narrowband light sources in the single-photon power regime by studying Hong$-$Ou$-$Mandel-like (HOM) interference between thermal states. Our results show that the absolute value of the frequency difference can be extracted from the temporal coincidence counts, and these results agree well with our theoretical model. We also demonstrate that the beat signal of the HOM-like interference between two thermal states has a similar oscillation profile to the HOM interference between two heralded single-photon sources, confirming that this method can be used to find the zero detuning of two heralded single-photon sources.

summaries.en: The paper proposes using Hong–Ou–Mandel-like interference between two independent narrowband thermal states to extract the absolute frequency difference—and identify zero detuning—in the single-photon power regime, with results matching a theoretical model and showing a beat signal shape similar to that of heralded single-photon HOM interference.
summaries.zh: 论文提出在单光子功率条件下，通过两独立窄带热态之间的Hong–Ou–Mandel类干涉来提取两光源的绝对频率差并确定零失谐，实验结果与理论模型一致，且其拍频信号形貌与前兆单光子HOＭ干涉相似，从而验证该方法可用于寻找前兆单光子之间的零失谐。

title: Uncertainty-aware quantum machine learning based on Dempster-Shafer theory
abstract: A large body of work in quantum machine learning has centered on characterizing the expressivity and performance of quantum models. In contrast, little attention has been paid to the reliability of predictions beyond average performance measures such as accuracy. In this work, we introduce an uncertainty-aware quantum classification framework based on Dempster-Shafer theory. This theory allows to express uncertainty through weights assigned not only to individual classification labels but to sets of labels. We introduce a training strategy that enables parameterized quantum circuits to learn such assignments directly from data. This provides an efficient way to prepare the corresponding quantum states and enables the application of different post-processing strategies. In particular, it offers a practical setting for quantum Dempster-Shafer fusion procedures with polynomial resource requirements, even when the corresponding mass functions are defined over exponentially many subsets. Overall, our work represents a step toward enabling quantum models to express uncertainty about their predictions, thereby extending the evaluation of quantum models beyond predictive performance alone.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Machine Learning (cs.LG); Machine Learning (stat.ML)

summaries.en: The paper proposes an uncertainty-aware quantum classification framework using Dempster–Shafer theory, with a training method that lets parameterized quantum circuits learn label-set mass assignments from data to efficiently enable uncertainty representation and Dempster–Shafer fusion with polynomial resources despite exponentially many subsets.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种基于德姆普斯-谢弗（Dempster–Shafer）理论的、面向不确定性的量子分类框架，并给出了训练方法，使参数化量子电路能够从数据中学习对标签集合的质量分配，从而在集合数量即使指数增长时仍能以多项式资源高效实现不确定性表达与德姆普斯-谢弗融合。

title: Unified master equation for driven multilevel quantum systems: Derivation, dynamics, and spectral signatures
abstract: Drive-modified dissipation in multilevel quantum systems is not, in general, accurately captured by conventional master equations. We derive a unified master equation using Lewis-Riesenfeld dynamical invariants, accommodating arbitrary driving within Born-Markov theory. We demonstrate the applicability of the unified master equation to constant-Rabi-coupling (continuous-wave), periodically-modulated-Rabi-coupling, and nonperiodic (ramped and chirped) driving protocols. Fluorescence spectra of a periodically driven three-level $\Lambda$ system reveal signatures missed by conventional descriptions. We trace the limitations of the conventional descriptions to inaccurate bath-frequency sampling and the neglect of nonsecular dissipative couplings, and map out the parameter regimes that require a unified treatment. The fluorescence spectra provide experimentally accessible signatures, which serve as a spectroscopic guide to reliable modeling of dissipative processes that can inform quantum control, simulation, sensing, and information processing.

summaries.en: The paper derives a unified Born-Markov master equation for arbitrarily driven multilevel quantum systems using Lewis-Riesenfeld dynamical invariants, showing that conventional approaches fail—especially for drive-modified dissipation—while the resulting fluorescence spectra of a periodically driven three-level Lambda system expose signatures that enable experimentally guided modeling of dissipative processes for quantum control and sensing.
summaries.zh: 论文基于刘易斯-里森菲尔德动力学不变量推导了适用于任意驱动多能级量子系统的统一Born-Markov主方程，表明传统方法无法准确描述驱动修正的耗散，并通过周期驱动的三能级Λ系统的荧光光谱给出其遗漏的特征，从而为实验上可靠建模耗散过程以服务于量子控制、模拟、测量与信息处理提供光谱指引。

title: Entanglement detection from moments of the realigned state: application to continuous-variable quantum systems
abstract: Certifying entanglement is a central problem in quantum information sciences, especially for continuous-variable quantum systems where full state tomography is experimentally demanding. We introduce a family of separability criteria based on the singular moments and weak moments of the operator obtained by applying the realignment map to the density operator. In practice, we find that the criterion based on the second-order moments of the realigned operator is already sufficient to witness the entanglement of a wide range of quantum optical states. The realigned moments can be readily accessed using an optical scheme consisting of a linear interferometer that couples several identical copies of the state, similarly to the multicopy technique used to measure the partial-transpose moments of a state [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 033064 (2026)]. We illustrate the detection capability of the second-order realigned-moment method for both Gaussian and non-Gaussian states, including lossy NOON states.

summaries.en: The paper proposes separability criteria for continuous-variable systems based on singular and weak moments of the realigned density-operator, showing that second-order moments are often sufficient for entanglement detection across many quantum optical states and can be measured via a linear-interferometer, multicopy scheme applicable to both Gaussian and non-Gaussian (including lossy NOON) states.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种用于连续变量量子系统的分离性判据，基于对密度算符施加实重排（realignment）映射后的算符进行奇异矩与弱矩分析，并指出二阶实重排矩在很大一类量子光学态中已足以见证纠缠，且可通过由线性干涉仪耦合多份相同态的光学多拷贝方案来获取，展示了该方法对高斯与非高斯（含有损NOON态）的检测能力。

title: Noise robust super-Heisenberg scaling in time-dependent quantum sensing by subspace-twirled dynamical decoupling
abstract: In quantum parameter estimation, time-dependent Hamiltonians can enable ultraprecise estimates of a physical parameter beyond the standard Heisenberg limit, also called the super-Heisenberg limit. However, achieving optimal scaling of the measurement precision typically requires an adaptive quantum control scheme which is resource-intensive and hard to implement in general. Furthermore, this advantage is often severely eroded by environmental noise. We propose the use of a dynamical decoupling scheme based on subspace twirling -- the averaging of random unitaries over a subspace rather than the entire Hilbert space -- to overcome these two limitations. We first prove necessary and sufficient conditions for subspace twirling to preserve the encoding signal while simultaneously removing environmental noise. We then establish conditions and provide performance guarantees for when time dependent Hamiltonians undergoing subspace twirling can achieve super-Heisenberg scaling without adaptive controls. Finally, we illustrate our results using an explicit example where a qubit sensor undergoing a subspace twirl simultaneously suppresses noise and achieves super-Heisenberg scaling. These results offer guidance for the design of ultraprecise quantum sensors under time-dependent and noisy conditions.

summaries.en: The paper shows that subspace-twirled dynamical decoupling can both eliminate environmental noise and preserve time-dependent parameter encoding, enabling super-Heisenberg (beyond the standard Heisenberg limit) scaling in quantum sensing without adaptive control, with proved conditions and an explicit qubit example.
summaries.zh: 论文证明基于子空间抽均（subspace twirling）的动力学解耦既能在时间依赖哈密顿量中保持参数编码信号、又能抑制环境噪声，从而在无需自适应控制的情况下实现量子测量精度的超海森堡（超过标准海森堡极限）标度，并给出严格条件与一个量子比特例子说明其有效性。

title: Implementation of a 1D Gaussian-modulated CV-QKD under finite-size parameter estimation
abstract: Continuous-variable quantum key distribution (CV-QKD) is a promising technology for quantum-secure communications, offering high secret-key rates and straightforward integration with coherent optical communication systems. Conventional Gaussian-modulated CV-QKD encodes information in both optical-field quadratures, increasing requirements for state preparation, modulation, and calibration, while potentially introducing additional preparation imperfections. Unidimensional (1D) Gaussian modulation offers a simpler alternative by encoding information in only one quadrature, while the conjugate quadrature constrains the protocol's security. However, an integrated experimental 1D implementation combining independent-laser coherent reception with practical reconciliation, finite-size parameter estimation, and privacy amplification remains challenging. Here, we experimentally demonstrate a 1D Gaussian-modulated CV-QKD system over 12~km of standard single-mode fiber using a local local oscillator (LLO) architecture with independent lasers and an integrated offline classical post-processing chain. The implementation includes coherent detection, digital signal processing, information reconciliation, parameter estimation, physicality-constrained security analysis, and privacy amplification. The 1D system achieves a privacy-amplified rate of $1.421$~Mbit/s under the asymptotic security treatment and $0.364$~Mbit/s under the finite-size scenario. These results establish an experimental baseline for the performance--complexity trade-off associated with unidimensional Gaussian modulation and provide an experimental basis for developing lower-complexity CV-QKD transmitters.

summaries.en: The paper experimentally implements a 1D Gaussian-modulated continuous-variable QKD system with independent-laser local oscillator architecture over 12 km of fiber, demonstrating integrated finite-size parameter estimation and privacy amplification with secret-key rates of 1.
summaries.zh: 本文在独立激光本振（LLO）架构下实现了基于一维高斯调制的连续变量量子密钥分发系统，并在12 km标准单模光纤上完成包含有限尺寸参数估计与隐私放大的集成实验，得到的安全密钥率在渐近情形为1.

title: A deployed four-city entanglement-based QKD network with real-time key delivery, benchmarked against finite-key security bounds
abstract: Quantum key distribution (QKD) generates shared secret keys whose security rests on the laws of physics rather than on computational assumptions. We report the entanglement-based segment of the Slovak national quantum communication infrastructure, connecting four cities in western Slovakia over deployed telecommunication fiber. Polarization-entangled photons generated at a central node are passively routed by wavelength to form a trusted-node-free, fully meshed sub-network of three cities, with the fourth connected through the central node and all links operated simultaneously. We also introduce a matrix formalism for passive wavelength routing that enables the algorithmic construction of uniquely and fully connected topologies. Unlike most previous demonstrations, which estimate key rates from raw coincidences, all rates reported here are obtained after the complete post-processing chain, with keys delivered in real time via ETSI GS QKD 014. With partial non-local chromatic dispersion compensation, we obtain 13.5 bit/s over 109 km, and 4.3 bit/s over 32.1 dB of accumulated loss between two cities without a direct fiber link. Benchmarking against finite-key security bounds shows that the implemented heuristic privacy amplification can exceed the finite-key bound, and that replacing detect-and-discard with error correction would increase the finite-key rate by a factor of 4.1-6.6, and yield a positive finite-key rate on the 142.9 km link where the implemented scheme yields none.

title: Observation of Genuine Multi-Time Quantum Memory
abstract: Memory effects in open quantum systems do not by themselves imply quantum memory, since non-Markovian dynamics can often be reproduced by classical-memory models. Known criteria certify the presence of quantum memory in the environment by comparing the evolution of the system at two different times. We show that quantum memory can remain hidden from all such pairwise tests and become detectable only when three or more times are considered jointly. We derive an analytical three-time witness and use it to certify quantum memory in a minimal qubit example in which every pair of times has a classical-memory explanation, thus establishing a strict hierarchy of quantum memory effects. Genuine multi-time quantum memory does not rely on fine-tuned time-dependent Hamiltonians or gate-based evolution. We experimentally demonstrate the hierarchy of quantum memory in a time-continuous realization on a superconducting-qubit platform with time-independent couplings.

summaries.en: The paper shows that quantum memory in open quantum systems can be invisible to all established two-time (pairwise) witness tests but becomes detectable only when three or more times are considered jointly, yielding a strict hierarchy that is derived analytically and experimentally verified on a superconducting-qubit platform with time-independent couplings.
summaries.zh: 本文指出，开放量子系统中的量子记忆可能对所有已知的两时间（成对）见证检验都“隐藏”，只有在联合考虑三个或更多时间时才会被探测到，并据此建立并推导严格的量子记忆层级，同时在具有时不变耦合的超导量子比特平台上进行时间连续实现的实验验证。

title: Traces of Vacuum Squeezing: A Superconducting Transmission-Line Analogue of Cosmological Particle Creation
abstract: Particle creation in time-dependent quantum fields is a central phenomenon in early-universe cosmology, yet it remains experimentally inaccessible in its original context. We show theoretically that superconducting circuits based on a waveguide-like transmission line loaded with dc-SQUIDs can provide a direct analogue of a scalar field in a radiation-dominated Friedmann--Robertson--Walker universe in conformal time. The mode equation of the circuit reduces to the Weber equation, the same equation governing cosmological particle creation in a radiation-dominated background, admitting an exact solution in terms of parabolic cylinder functions and an exponentially suppressed particle spectrum. We analyse the conditions under which the analogy holds, which require a compromise between the duration of the pulse, the uniformity of the modulation and the symmetry of the SQUIDs, and show that dissipation does not erase the cosmological signal. We use the anomalous moment of each mode as a witness of the Bogoliubov mixing: it vanishes for any thermal state and survives dissipation, and, together with the photon number, it certifies squeezing, and with the purity of the state, it identifies whether the pairs created from the vacuum dominate.

summaries.en: The paper shows that a superconducting waveguide transmission line loaded with dc-SQUIDs can emulate cosmological particle creation in a radiation-dominated Friedmann–Robertson–Walker universe, where the circuit mode dynamics map to the Weber equation, yielding an exponentially suppressed particle spectrum and allowing cosmological squeezing to be detected via anomalous moments that persist despite dissipation under specific modulation-duration, uniformity, and SQUID-symmetry conditions.
summaries.zh: 论文提出：在由带有直流SQUID的类波导超导传输线构成的电路中，可以对辐射主导的弗里德曼—罗伯逊—沃克宇宙中的宇宙学粒子产生进行直接类比，其中电路的模方程可化为描述该背景粒子产生的Weber方程并得到以抛物圆柱函数表示的精确解，从而产生指数抑制的粒子谱；并在满足脉冲持续时间、调制均匀性与SQUID对称性等条件且考虑耗散不消除信号的情况下，利用每个模的反常矩作为Bogoliubov混合的见证来表征真空压缩并区分由真空产生的粒子对是否占主导。

title: Quantum Metrology and Quantum Battery in a Hyperfine-Coupled Spin System
abstract: We investigate multiparameter quantum metrology and the energetic properties of an effective electron--proton spin system inspired by the hyperfine structure of the hydrogen atom. Considering the external magnetic field $\mathcal B$ and the hyperfine coupling strength $\Lambda$ as unknown parameters, we derive the quantum Fisher information matrix and establish the corresponding quantum Cramér--Rao bounds for their simultaneous estimation. We analyze the estimation precision and the correlations between the two parameters, showing that the weak-commutativity condition is satisfied despite the noncommutativity of the associated symmetric logarithmic derivatives. Independently, we explore the energetic properties of the system under a unitary charging protocol, characterizing its ergotropy, anti-ergotropy, storage capacity, and energy-basis coherence. We investigate the dependence of these quantities on the magnetic field, hyperfine coupling, temperature, and charging time. Our results provide a comprehensive characterization of the metrological properties and energetic performance of a hyperfine spin-based quantum system, highlighting its potential as a platform for quantum sensing and energy storage.

summaries.en: The paper derives the quantum Fisher information matrix and quantum Cramér–Rao bounds for simultaneously estimating an external magnetic field and hyperfine coupling in an effective electron–proton spin system, showing weak-commutativity holds, and it further analyzes how quantum battery metrics (ergotropy, anti-ergotropy, storage capacity, and energy-basis coherence) evolve with field, coupling, temperature, and charging time under unitary charging to assess its sensing and energy-storage potential.
summaries.zh: 论文推导了在受氢原子超精细结构启发的等效电子—质子自旋体系中同时估计外磁场与超精细耦合强度的量子费舍尔信息矩阵及量子克拉美–罗界，并证明尽管对称对数导数不对易仍满足弱可对易条件；随后在单一幺正充电协议下研究量子电池指标（绝对/反绝对功密度、存储容量与能量基相干）随磁场、耦合、温度与充电时间的变化，从而评估其作为量子传感与能量存储平台的潜力。

title: Optical trapping of neutral atoms via magnetic-dipole transitions
abstract: Optical trapping of neutral atoms is almost universally described as an electric-dipole (E1) effect. We show that the magnetic field of light, acting on a magnetic-dipole (M1) transition, can induce an ac Zeeman shift significantly larger than the ac Stark shift, thereby enabling magnetic trapping. We construct the M1 polarizability tensor and identify a critical detuning $\delta_c$, independent of optical power, below which the magnetic interaction dominates. We analyze suitable trapping parameters and possible loss mechanisms, particularly for the intraconfigurational transitions $^3H_6\rightarrow{}^3H_5$ of erbium at $1437.13$~nm and $^5I_8\rightarrow{}^5I_7$ of dysprosium at $2418.84$~nm. We propose two trapping configurations: a hybrid magnetic/electric optical tweezer and an optical lattice with separated magnetic and electric antinodes, producing state-dependent purely magnetic and purely electric trapping wells. Our results present optical magnetic fields as a suitable resource to expand the toolbox for atomic manipulation.

summaries.en: The paper shows that neutral atoms can be optically trapped using magnetic-dipole (M1) transitions where the light’s magnetic field produces an ac Zeeman shift exceeding the usual electric-dipole (E1) ac Stark shift, constructing the M1 polarizability tensor and identifying a power-independent critical detuning to enable predominantly magnetic trapping, with analyzed loss mechanisms and proposed hybrid and lattice configurations for erbium and dysprosium.
summaries.zh: 本文指出可利用磁场光的磁二极跃迁（M1）实现中性原子的光学俘获：光的磁场诱导的交流塞曼位移可显著大于常规电二极跃迁（E1）带来的交流斯塔克位移，并据此构建M1极化率张量、给出与光功率无关的临界失谐以实现以磁相互作用为主的俘获，结合对损耗机制的分析并提出用于铒与镝的混合磁/电光镊及分离磁电反节点的光晶格两种俘获方案，从而将光学磁场作为原子操控的新资源扩展工具箱。

title: Quantum-logic detection of rotationally inelastic collisions of single molecules
abstract: Collisions between molecules govern chemical reactions and energy transfer across a range of different environments from interstellar space to the Earth's atmosphere. Despite their fundamental importance, molecular collisions have traditionally been studied through ensemble-averaged experiments which obscure the dynamics of individual scattering events on the quantum level. Probing single molecular collisions with quantum-state resolution has thus far remained a major experimental challenge. Here, we demonstrate a method for detecting individual rotationally inelastic collisions of single molecular ions with neutral atoms using quantum-logic techniques. We prepare individual trapped N$_2^+$ ions in their rotational ground state, subject them to a beam of helium atoms and detect isolated collision events through their effects on the motion of the trapped ions. Quantum-logic-spectroscopic measurements reveal changes of the molecular state upon collision enabling the determination of the probability of rotationally inelastic scattering. The experiments are analysed by comparison with quantum and classical scattering calculations yielding detailed insights into the underlying collision dynamics. By combining single-collision detection with non-destructive readout of the molecular quantum state, our approach establishes a new experimental framework for investigating molecular scattering beyond conventional ensemble measurements. It opens a route towards investigating state-to-state scattering in individual molecules and exploring molecular interactions at the level of single quantum-state resolved events.
subjects: Atomic Physics (physics.atom-ph) ; Chemical Physics (physics.chem-ph); Quantum Physics (quant-ph)

summaries.en: The paper reports a quantum-logic–based technique that detects single rotationally inelastic collisions of trapped N2+ molecular ions with helium atoms, using non-destructive quantum-state readout and comparisons to scattering calculations to extract collision probabilities and insights into the underlying dynamics beyond ensemble-averaged measurements.

title: Buffer-Gas-Assisted Fluorescence Spectroscopy of Molecular Ions
abstract: Sustained fluorescence detection of generic molecules has been challenging due to the lack of cycling transitions and limited photon budgets. We demonstrate a nondestructive method for continuous fluorescence of strongly rovibronically open molecular ions, $^{232}$ThF$^+$. Effective quasi-cycling transitions are established by room-temperature buffer-gas collisions, which replenish the population back to the laser-addressed states. In situ images and rotationally resolved spectra are obtained without optical repumping or auxiliary atomic readout ions. Combined with low-background spectroscopic detection, this approach achieves a signal-to-noise ratio of approximately 6 in a 1 s exposure on the P(1) line of $^{232}$ThF$^+$, despite a thermal population of only approximately 0.17% in the addressed state at room temperature. The ability to repeatedly interrogate trapped ions is particularly promising for scarce molecular samples, broadband spectroscopic searches, and in situ monitoring of molecular reactions.

title: Laser cooling of $\mathrm{Th}^{-}$: Revised bound-state structure and a more efficient cooling scheme
abstract: The thorium anion ($\mathrm{Th}^{-}$) has been proposed as a candidate for laser cooling of negative ions. However, previous theoretical and experimental results exhibit significant discrepancies in both the excitation energies and lifetimes. Here we revisit the bound-state structure and transition properties of $\mathrm{Th}^{-}$ using two independent ab initio approaches. The two calculations agree well and improve agreement with measured excitation energies and lifetimes. Based on the present level structure, we reassign several observed levels and show that the previously proposed $^4F^e_{3/2}\leftrightarrow{}^2S^o_{1/2}$ cooling transition is not closed and requires two repumping lasers. We therefore propose an alternative cooling scheme based on the $^4F^e_{3/2}\leftrightarrow{}^4F^o_{3/2}$ transition, which requires only one repumping laser and has a transition rate approximately five times larger ($A\approx1.1\times10^5$ s$^{-1}$), the fastest reported bound--bound E1 transition in atomic anions to date.

title: Spectroscopy of ultracold molecules in the mid-infrared
abstract: Unlike the microwave and optical domains, frequency metrology in the mid-infrared has not yet benefited from the long coherence times and exquisite control provided by ultracold particles. We use a quantum cascade laser operating at 17.5 THz to drive ro-vibrational transitions in ultracold calcium monofluoride molecules. The laser linewidth is narrowed to 15 kHz by locking it to a custom mid-infrared ring cavity, which is in turn locked to an ultrastable laser. We study the spectrum for molecules confined in red-detuned and blue-detuned magneto-optical traps, and in an optical dipole trap. In the dipole trap, the spectroscopic linewidth is close to that of the laser. We consider the stability and accuracy that can be reached using these methods in the context of a broader programme for improving frequency metrology in the mid-infrared.
